name: ActivateDesignOptionsInCombinations
description: Activates one design option in each of the given combinations, without listing all active design options of the combination. Available from Archicad 29.

name: ActivateLayerCombination
description: Activates the given layer combination in the current window, like choosing it in the Quick Layers palette. Saved views are not changed.

name: AddCommentToIssue
description: Adds a new comment to the specified issue.

name: AddFilesToEmbeddedLibrary
description: Adds the given files into the embedded library. With the overwriteExisting flag an embedded library item already existing on an outputPath is replaced (Archicad 27 or newer).

name: AddLibraries
description: Adds the given folders to the project's local libraries, skipping any already loaded.

name: AddLoadCasesToLoadCombination
description: Adds load cases with their factors to the given structural analysis load combination in one undo step.

name: AddMEPPreferenceTableRows
description: Adds rows with the given keys and optionally values to a branch, elbow or transition preference table and returns their index, in one undo step. Branch tables from Archicad 28, elbow and transition tables from Archicad 29; segment tables have a row for each reference id. On Archicad 27 a row is added to the list of the given shape of any preference table, and the index of each new row after the call is returned. Available from Archicad 27.

name: AddPropertyToAttributes
description: Makes an existing custom property available for the given attributes (for example Building Materials), in one undo step. Available in Archicad 25, 26 and 27 only.

name: AlignElements
description: Aligns elements on the floor plan or in the current 2D view to one edge of their plan bounding boxes (left, right, top or bottom) or to their middle (centerX, centerY), either of the whole set or of a reference element, by moving them in one undo step. The bounding boxes are those Get2DBoundingBoxes returns. Supported types: Wall, Column, Beam, Slab, Roof, Shell, Morph, Mesh, Zone, Object, Lamp, Stair, Railing, CurtainWall, Line, PolyLine, Arc, Circle, Spline, Hatch, Text and Hotspot. An element of another type (doors, windows and openings, which only slide along their host, subelements, dimensions, labels, ...) or one that cannot be edited gets a failed execution result naming the reason, and the other elements are still aligned.

name: ApplyFavoriteToToolDefault
description: Makes the settings of the given Favorite the settings of its tool, and returns the element type of that tool. Available from Archicad 29.

name: ApplyFavoritesToElementDefaults
description: Apply the given favorites to element defaults.

name: ApplyFavoritesToElements
description: Apply the given favorites to existing elements. Only settings-type parameters are changed - geometry (position, floor, and dimensions such as a Wall's height) is left untouched, so applying a Favorite never moves the target element. A Window or Door keeps its wall, marker and placement, and takes the Favorite's library part and parameters, size included. For the hierarchical types (Stair, Railing, Curtain Wall) the settings of the sub-elements are not applied, because they are inseparable from the Favorite's own geometry. By default settings, classifications, categories and properties are all applied; each can be opted out of individually. keepFields lists fields of the target (its ID, layer, an opening's width, height and sill height, a Wall's reference line location, height and top link) that are copied back after the Favorite has been applied, so that e.g. only the library part or the wall type changes. With favorite instead of favoritesToApply, one Favorite is read once and applied to the given elements, or to every element of its type that matches the filter.

name: AttachElementsToIssue
description: Attaches elements to the specified issue.

name: BreakHotlinkNodes
description: Breaks hotlink nodes, as the Hotlink Manager's Break Hotlink does: the elements of each node's placed instances stay in the project as ordinary elements, no longer tied to the source file.

name: CalculateSunPosition
description: Calculates the sun position (azimuth and altitude in degrees) for a date and time, at the project location unless another one is given, without changing the project.

name: CanMoveElementsToDesignOptions
description: Checks whether the given elements can be moved to another design option or to the main model, with the reason when they cannot. Available from Archicad 29.

name: CaptureElementState
description: Captures the current state of the elements of the project and returns a stateId for it, so that GetElementChangesSince can later list what was created, modified and deleted since. The optional type selects how changes are detected (modification stamps by default, or the 3D model). The state is kept in a file in the temporary folder for the Archicad session only: it is lost when the project is closed or Archicad restarts, and ReleaseElementState frees it earlier.

name: Change3DStyles
description: Changes the given fields of existing 3D styles, identified by name. Available from Archicad 27.

name: ChangeAddOnViewpoints
description: Changes the ID, name, view settings flags or attached data (base64 encoded) of the given add-on viewpoint items; only the given fields are changed. Roots and groups can't be changed in a Teamwork project. Available from Archicad 27.

name: ChangeDrawingLink
description: Relinks a Drawing to a different source navigator item. Archicad has no in-place relink API, so this recreates the Drawing against the new source and deletes the original - the returned elementId is a NEW guid, not the input one. The Drawing Title marker's own position is not preserved (undocumented Archicad limitation). The new source view is made current before the Drawing is created (Archicad 27 or later), and the window and story that were active when the command started are restored afterwards; the view settings (zoom, layers, scale) shown in that window are not restored.

name: ChangeFavorite
description: Gives an existing Favorite the settings of another Favorite or of the current Opening tool default. Available from Archicad 29.

name: ChangeHotlinkInstances
description: Moves, rotates or mirrors placed hotlink instances by changing their transformation. MoveElements and RotateElements do not work on hotlink instances.

name: ChangeHotlinkNodes
description: Repoints hotlink module nodes at other source files, as the Hotlink Manager's Relink button does. Follow it with UpdateHotlinks to re-read the content.

name: ChangeLibraryPartOfElements
description: Changes the library part of the given Object, Lamp, Window, Door, Skylight, Zone and symbol Label elements to another library part of the same type, given by name, index or guid, e.g. to replace missing library parts with ones from the loaded libraries. The elements themselves (guid, properties, classifications) are kept. Components of stairs and railings are not supported, even when they are reported as Objects. Optionally keeps the values of the GDL parameters with the same name and type, and the size (A and B).

name: ChangeSelectionOfElements
description: Adds/removes a number of elements to/from the current selection.

name: ChangeTextContent
description: Replaces a range of the content of Text elements and text Labels, keeping the styles of the runs and the autotexts in the rest of the content.

name: ChangeWindow
description: Changes the current (active) window to the given window. A databaseId on its own is enough; the window type is taken from the database. The databaseId of a worksheet or detail whose window was never opened opens its Project Map item instead (from Archicad 27). With windowType 'FloorPlan' and a storyIndex it also activates that story on the floor plan. windowType 'Report' on its own opens the Session Report window (from Archicad 26); its text cannot be read through the Archicad API.

name: CheckLibraries
description: Checks the loaded libraries with the Archicad API's library check. Returns the error the API reports, if any.

name: CheckMEPPortConnectability
description: Checks whether MEP ports can be connected to other ports, for the given pairs of ports. Archicad 28 and later check the physical connection. Available from Archicad 27.

name: CheckPropertyValues
description: Checks whether the given values are acceptable for the given property definitions, without changing anything.

name: CloneProjectMapItemToViewMap
description: Clones Project Map viewpoints into a specified View Map folder.

name: CloseProject
description: Closes the currently opened project.

name: CloseWindows
description: Closes the windows of the given databases (for example layouts, sections or details opened earlier with ChangeWindow), with one execution result per window; a window Archicad cannot close gets a failed result. Requires Archicad 27 or later.

name: CompareLibraryPartUnIds
description: Compares two library part unique IDs with Archicad's own comparison and tells whether their main and revision GUIDs are the same.

name: ConnectMEPElements
description: Connects MEP routing elements to other MEP elements or routes. Merges routes, splits routes or creates branch elements as needed. The first or last node of the 'connectToId' route must lie exactly on the 'routingElementId' route, so for a tee pass the main route as 'routingElementId' and the branch as 'connectToId'. A failed connection says which condition is not met. Archicad 27 does not report the merged, split or created elements. Available from Archicad 27.

name: ConnectToElectricalCircuits
description: Connects electrical devices, or panels as sub-panels, to electrical circuits. Available from Archicad 30.

name: ConsolidateFills
description: Runs the Fill Consolidation menu command of Archicad on the current window, as the menu does, and reports whether it ran together with what Archicad answered. Available from Archicad 27.

name: ConsolidateLines
description: Runs the Line Consolidation menu command of Archicad on the current window, as the menu does, and reports whether it ran together with what Archicad answered. Available from Archicad 27.

name: ConvertAnalyticalLinksToNonShortest
description: Converts the given shortest analytical links (associative to a curve member or a surface member edge) to links connected to a fixed coordinate, in one undo step, and returns the converted links. Available from Archicad 26.

name: ConvertImages
description: Converts base64 encoded images from one image format to another with Archicad's own image converters, for example a PNG preview image to JPEG. The formats are Bitmap, GIF, TIFF, JPEG and PNG, or the MIME type of another format Archicad can read or write. The output is aligned with the input array of images. Changes nothing in the project.

name: ConvertRevealOffsets
description: Converts the reveal depth offset of windows and doors placed in walls between the two references Archicad uses: measured from the core skin of a composite wall, or from the wall side. Give exactly one of coreOffset or sideOffset per opening; both values are returned. For walls with a basic structure the two values are equal. The output is aligned with the input array of openings. Available from Archicad 27.

name: ConvertUnitValues
description: Formats lengths, areas, volumes and angles (given in meters, square meters, cubic meters and radians) as Archicad shows them with the unit and rounding of the given Project Preference, returning the text, its extra accuracy decimals and the unit. The output is aligned with the input array of values. Available from Archicad 27.

name: CopyElements
description: Copies elements by an offset, like dragging a copy in Archicad, keeping all their settings. With count, copy n is moved by n times the offset, which makes a linear array. Returns the new elements of each given element, in the order of the given ones; an element Archicad cannot copy (a part of a curtain wall, stair or railing, a locked element or one on a hidden or locked layer, ...) gets an error naming the reason, and the other elements are still copied. All copies are one undo step.

name: CopyElementsToDatabase
description: Copies 2D elements (lines, polylines, arcs, circles, splines, hotspots, texts, hatches, independent labels) from one database into another, e.g. from a worksheet into another worksheet, a detail or a layout, optionally moved by an offset. Returns the new elements in the order of the given ones.

name: CopyFilesIntoEmbeddedLibrary
description: Copies the given files, keeping their names, into a folder of the embedded library with one library operation. The target folder is created when it is missing. With overwriteIfExists an item of the same name in that folder is replaced.

name: CopyLibraryParts
description: Copies loaded library parts, given by name or by an element placed from them, under a new file name into a folder, by default the embedded library. The copy gets a new unique ID unless the main GUID is kept. An existing file is never overwritten. The libraries are reloaded once afterwards, so the copies can be found by name. Available from Archicad 28.

name: Create3DStyles
description: Creates 3D styles. Each new style starts from the current 3D style and differs from it only in the given fields. Available from Archicad 27.

name: CreateAddOnViewpoints
description: Creates add-on viewpoint roots, groups and leaf nodes in the Project Map, with their ID, name, view settings flags (leaf nodes only) and attached data (base64 encoded). A group or a leaf node is created in the given parent root or group. Returns the identifier of each new item, or an error for an item that could not be created. Roots and groups can't be created in a Teamwork project. Available from Archicad 27.

name: CreateAnalyticalLinks
description: Creates analytical links from their settings and connected member parts, as GetAnalyticalLinks returns them, in one undo step. Available from Archicad 26.

name: CreateAnalyticalLoadCases
description: Creates structural analysis load cases in the given load groups in one undo step and returns their identifiers.

name: CreateAnalyticalLoadCombinations
description: Creates structural analysis load combinations, optionally with their load factors, in one undo step and returns their identifiers. The combination type is available from Archicad 27.

name: CreateAnalyticalLoadGroups
description: Creates structural analysis load groups in one undo step and returns their identifiers.

name: CreateAnalyticalLoads
description: Creates analytical point, edge and surface loads from their settings, loaded member part and custom data, as GetAnalyticalLoads returns them, in one undo step. Available from Archicad 26.

name: CreateAnalyticalSupports
description: Creates analytical supports from their settings and supported member part, as GetAnalyticalSupports returns them, in one undo step. Available from Archicad 26.

name: CreateArcs
description: Creates Arc elements based on the given parameters.

name: CreateAssociativeDimensions
description: Creates associative dimensions from explicit witness point references: linear by default, or cumulative, baseline or elevation dimensions (appearance). A witness point can also be static, given by its coordinate instead of an element.

name: CreateAssociativeDimensionsOnSection
description: Creates associative dimensions on section elements using common wall, slab, beam, column, door and window presets: linear by default, or cumulative, baseline or elevation dimensions (appearance), e.g. level marks. The preset points of multiple section elements can be merged into one continuous dimension chain via sectionElementIds. For Opening tool elements, which Archicad does not associate with dimensions, the OpeningEdges preset places fixed points at their edges instead.

name: CreateAttributeFolders
description: Creates attribute folders, each given by attribute type and path (the folder names from the root folder down). Missing parent folders are created too; a folder that already exists is kept and reported as success. Available from Archicad 26.

name: CreateBeams
description: Creates Beam elements based on the given parameters. Takes the same cut fill pens and cover fill as ModifyBeams, besides the position, shape, slant and cross section; settings not given come from the Beam tool defaults or the favorite. Not written by either command: the surfaces of the beam segments, and the cut fill pens before Archicad 27.

name: CreateBuildingMaterials
description: Creates or overwrites Building Material attributes based on the given parameters.

name: CreateCircles
description: Creates Circle elements based on the given parameters.

name: CreateClassificationItems
description: Creates Classification Items in the given Classification Systems based on the given parameters.

name: CreateClassificationSystems
description: Creates Classification Systems including Classification Items based on the given parameters.

name: CreateColumns
description: Creates Column elements based on the given parameters. Takes the same cut fill pens and cover fill as ModifyColumns, besides the position, size, slant, cross section and veneer; settings not given come from the Column tool defaults or the favorite. Not written by either command: the surfaces of the column segments, and the cut fill pens before Archicad 27.

name: CreateComposites
description: Creates or overwrites Composite attributes based on the given parameters.

name: CreateCurtainWalls
description: Creates Curtain Wall elements along a reference polyline with a column (primary) and row (secondary) pattern. The frame and panel classes come from the favorite or from the Curtain Wall tool defaults; the pattern cells can assign them to the grid.

name: CreateDesignOptionCombinations
description: Creates new design option combinations with the given parameters. Available from Archicad 29.

name: CreateDesignOptionSets
description: Creates new design option sets with the given names. Available from Archicad 29.

name: CreateDesignOptions
description: Creates new design options with the given parameters. Available from Archicad 29.

name: CreateDetailMarkers
description: Places Detail markers with their clip polygon in the current floor plan, section or elevation, each with a new Detail viewpoint, like the Detail tool. GetDetailsOfElements reads them back.

name: CreateDetails
description: Creates independent Detail databases. Returns the databaseId and the Project Map navigatorItemId of each new detail.

name: CreateDoors
description: Creates Door elements in host walls based on the given parameters.

name: CreateDrawings
description: Creates Drawing elements on the specified or active layout from navigator items.

name: CreateElectricalCircuits
description: Adds new circuits to electrical panels, optionally with the given description, voltage, wiring type and used phases. Available from Archicad 30.

name: CreateElectricalDevices
description: Places electrical devices with the default settings of the Electrical Device tool, optionally with the given library part, size, rotation, mirroring, apparent power and load classification, and connects them to a circuit. Available from Archicad 30.

name: CreateElectricalPanels
description: Places electrical panels with the default settings of the Electrical Panel tool, optionally with the given library part, size, rotation, mirroring, panel name and circuit naming. Available from Archicad 30.

name: CreateElementSets
description: Creates element sets of the given elements. An element set is a hidden, persistent collection of elements (it is not a group and has no effect on selection or editing).

name: CreateElementsFromAnalyticalMembers
description: Creates elements (beams, columns, walls, slabs, roofs) from the given curve, surface or segmented surface members, in the form GetAnalyticalMemberDetails returns them, optionally with the settings of a favorite, in one undo step. Returns the new elements and, from Archicad 26, the mapping of their edges and vertices to member parts.

name: CreateElevations
description: Creates Elevation elements on the floor plan. The floor plan must be the active window: creation fails while a Section or Elevation window is active.

name: CreateFavorite
description: Creates a Favorite in the given folder from the settings of another Favorite or of the current Opening tool default. conflictPolicy says what happens when the name is taken: fail, skip, overwrite the existing Favorite's settings or create the new one under a free name. Available from Archicad 29.

name: CreateFavoriteFolder
description: Creates a folder in the Favorites palette, in the parent folder given by its path. Returns the new folder. Available from Archicad 29.

name: CreateFavoritesFromElements
description: Create favorites from the given elements.

name: CreateFills
description: Creates or overwrites Fill attributes based on the given parameters.

name: CreateFolderInEmbeddedLibrary
description: Creates a folder, with any missing parent folders, inside the embedded library. The folderPath is relative to the embedded library, like the outputPath of AddFilesToEmbeddedLibrary.

name: CreateGraphicOverrideCombinations
description: Creates graphic override combinations from existing rules. Available from Archicad 27.

name: CreateGraphicOverrideRuleGroups
description: Creates empty graphic override rule groups. Available from Archicad 27.

name: CreateGraphicOverrideRules
description: Creates graphic override rules. The criterion is given as Archicad's criterion XML or as structured conditions. The rule group is created when no rule group has the given name. Available from Archicad 27.

name: CreateGraphicalOverrideCombination
description: Creates a graphic override combination from rule names, or replaces the rules of an existing one. Needs Archicad 27 or later.

name: CreateGraphicalOverrideRule
description: Creates or overwrites a graphic override rule in a rule group: name, criterion XML, surface color and line pen. Needs Archicad 27 or later.

name: CreateGridElements
description: Creates grid elements, the elements the Grid Tool places, from begin and end coordinates, with optional story, layer and GDL parameters. Needs Archicad 26 or later.

name: CreateGroups
description: Creates groups of the passed elements

name: CreateHatches
description: Creates Hatch elements based on the given parameters. A hatch can have holes, in the same format SetDetailsOfElements accepts for hatches.

name: CreateHotlinkInstances
description: Places instances of hotlink module nodes at an origin, rotation and mirroring.

name: CreateHotlinkNodes
description: Creates hotlink module nodes from source files. A node that already points at the same file is returned instead of duplicated (Archicad 26 and later; 25 cannot see an unplaced node).

name: CreateHotspots
description: Creates Hotspot elements based on the given parameters.

name: CreateInteriorElevations
description: Creates Interior Elevation elements on the floor plan. Every consecutive pair of the given points becomes one segment, each with its own viewpoint - feed it the corner points of a room to get an interior elevation of that room.

name: CreateIssue
description: Creates a new issue.

name: CreateKeynoteFolders
description: Creates keynote folders under the given parent folders (or under the root folder). Available from Archicad 28.

name: CreateKeynoteItems
description: Creates keynote items in the given parent folders (or in the root folder). Available from Archicad 28.

name: CreateKeynoteLabels
description: Creates Label elements that reference the given keynote items via autotext. Available from Archicad 28.

name: CreateLabels
description: Creates Label elements based on the given parameters.

name: CreateLamps
description: Creates Lamp elements based on the given parameters. A library part named in libraryPartName starts from its own default size and GDL parameters, not from those of the part the Lamp tool holds; the dimensions and the GDL parameters given (by name, in parameters) override them. layerIndex places the element on a layer. With databaseId the lamps are placed in that database, e.g. a worksheet, instead of the current one.

name: CreateLayerCombinations
description: Creates or overwrites Layer Combination attributes based on the given parameters.

name: CreateLayers
description: Creates or overwrites Layer attributes based on the given parameters.

name: CreateLayout
description: Creates Layouts and their backing master layouts. Archicad inserts a new layout at the first place of its subset, renumbering the sheets after it; previousNavigatorItemId or position 'last' places it after an existing sheet or at the end instead. A custom layout number does not leave the layout out of the numbering; layoutParameters.doNotIncludeInNumbering does. A layout that was created but could not be placed is returned with both its databaseId and the error.

name: CreateLayoutSubset
description: Creates Layout Book subsets.

name: CreateLevelDimensions
description: Creates Level Dimension elements (the Level Dimension tool) based on the given parameters. With a parentElementId the dimension is associative: it shows the height of the parent element (Mesh, Slab, Roof ...) at its position and follows the element when it changes.

name: CreateLibraryPart
description: Creates a new library part file (.gsm) of the given loaded subtype, inheriting its parameters, and reports whether it is loaded with its index and names. Available from Archicad 28.

name: CreateLibraryPartFromElements
description: Creates a library part in the embedded library (or in a given local library folder, which is added to the loaded libraries when needed) whose 2D symbol is a copy of the given 2D drawing elements (lines, polylines, arcs, circles, splines, fills, texts and hotspots), under the given parent subtype, with optional master, 2D, 3D and parameter scripts, comment and keywords. A and B are taken from the extent of the symbol. The elements themselves are not changed.

name: CreateLibraryParts
description: Creates GDL library parts in the embedded library from their scripts (master, 2D, 3D, parameter, interface, properties) and parameter definitions, under the given parent subtype. The new parts are placeable right away, e.g. with CreateObjects. With the overwriteExisting flag an embedded library item already existing on the path of a new part is replaced (Archicad 27 or newer).

name: CreateLineElements
description: Creates Line elements based on the given parameters.

name: CreateLines
description: Creates or overwrites Line attributes based on the given parameters.

name: CreateMEPElements
description: Creates MEP elements (Terminal, Accessory, Equipment or Fitting) at the given positions, optionally with another library part, size (from Archicad 30), MEP system, port sizes and shapes and a changed insulation, which apply only to what is placed. Available from Archicad 28.

name: CreateMEPFlexibleSegments
description: Creates MEP flexible segments through the given control points, or along a polyline of alternating line and spline parts (Piping), with the current settings of the Flexible Segment tool of their domain, optionally with the orientation (control points) or direction (polyline) at both ends. Available from Archicad 28.

name: CreateMEPPhysicalSystems
description: Creates physical systems in MEP system groups, optionally with a root element and an MEP system as their category. Available from Archicad 29.

name: CreateMEPPreferenceTables
description: Adds empty preference tables with the given names to the preference table container of a domain of Archicad 27 and returns their id, in one undo step. Only for Archicad 27.

name: CreateMEPRoutingElements
description: Creates MEP routing elements (duct, pipe or cable carrier routes) along the given polylines with optional cross section data (shape, size, preference table and reference id), MEP system and layer (also set on the segments, elbows and transitions), and optional elbow and transition defaults (preference tables and elbow radius factor, from Archicad 29) that apply only to what is placed. Available from Archicad 28.

name: CreateMEPSystemGroups
description: Creates MEP system groups. Available from Archicad 29.

name: CreateMEPSystems
description: Creates or overwrites MEP System attributes (domain, pens, fill, center line type, surface and insulation surface) based on the given parameters.

name: CreateMEPTakeOffs
description: Creates MEP take-offs on the given routing segments, at a distance from the beginning of the segment (not more than its length) and optionally rotated around its axis by a multiple of 90 degrees, with the current settings of the Take-Off tool of their domain (by default the domain of the segment's routing element), optionally with their length and without insulation, which apply only to what is created. Archicad only has Ventilation take-offs. Available from Archicad 28.

name: CreateMeshes
description: Creates Mesh elements based on the given parameters.

name: CreateMorphs
description: Creates Morph elements from simple box definitions or arbitrary bodies. Each item may name a favorite (favoriteName) to start from, a layer (layerIndex) and an Element ID (id); the given geometry and floor are kept.

name: CreateObjects
description: Creates Object elements based on the given parameters. A library part named in libraryPartName starts from its own default size and GDL parameters, not from those of the part the Object tool holds; the dimensions and the GDL parameters given (by name, in parameters) override them. layerIndex places the element on a layer. With databaseId the objects are placed in that database, e.g. a worksheet, instead of the current one.

name: CreateOpenings
description: Creates Opening elements in the given host elements.

name: CreatePenTables
description: Creates or overwrites Pen Table attributes based on the given parameters.

name: CreatePolylines
description: Creates Polyline elements based on the given parameters.

name: CreateProfiles
description: Creates or overwrites Profile attributes as a copy of an existing Profile's geometry, based on the given parameters.

name: CreateProjectInfoFields
description: Creates one or more custom project info fields. From Archicad 30 the Project Info group of each field can be given; without it the field goes to the first group.

name: CreateProjectInfoGroups
description: Creates Project Info groups with the given names, at the end of the group list. Available from Archicad 30.

name: CreatePropertyDefinitions
description: Creates Custom Property Definitions based on the given parameters.

name: CreatePropertyGroups
description: Creates Property Groups based on the given parameters.

name: CreateRailings
description: Creates Railing elements along a reference polyline. Posts, rails, handrails, toprails, panels and balusters come from the favorite, from an existing railing (templateElementId) or from the Railing tool defaults; Archicad generates one node per vertex and one segment per pair of consecutive vertices.

name: CreateRailingsFromPolyline
description: Creates Railing elements along a 3D reference polyline: each node has its own elevation and segments can be arcs. Posts, rails, handrails, toprails, panels and balusters come from the favorite or from the Railing tool defaults.

name: CreateRoofs
description: Creates Roof elements based on footprint, level and roof profile data. Creates a multi-plane roof by default; pass 'pivotLine' (and optionally 'angle') to create a single-plane roof instead.

name: CreateSections
description: Creates Section elements on the floor plan. A section looks to the left of its start to end direction, with its depth line that far on that side. GetDetailsOfElements reads the geometry of existing sections back. The floor plan must be the active window: creation fails while a Section or Elevation window is active.

name: CreateShells
description: Creates extruded, revolved and ruled Shell elements from profile polylines, with thickness, structure, an optional clipping contour and holes.

name: CreateSkylights
description: Creates Skylight elements with a roof or shell owner and a floor plan anchor position. It takes the same settings as ModifySkylights (anchor point, fix mode, width, height, azimuth and elevation angles, mirroring, floor plan display, pens, line types, section fill, surface and the library part flags) and optionally a library part; the settings not given come from the Skylight tool defaults or a favorite. Surface placement is handled by Archicad and has not yet been verified for this command.

name: CreateSlabs
description: Creates Slab elements based on the given parameters. Takes the same surfaces (top, side, bottom), cut fill pens and floor fill as ModifySlabs, besides the outline, holes, level and structure; settings not given come from the Slab tool defaults or the favorite. Not written by either command: the surface of a single edge, and the cut fill pens before Archicad 27; of the floor fill orientation Archicad applies only the type through the API.

name: CreateSolidElementLinks
description: Creates solid element operation links between target and operator elements.

name: CreateSolidOperations
description: Runs a solid operation (subtraction, intersection, addition) on two morphs and returns the resulting morphs, one item per operation. Unlike CreateSolidElementLinks this is not a link: the target and the operator morph are replaced by the result. Morphs only; the operations run in one undo step.

name: CreateSplines
description: Creates Spline elements based on the given parameters.

name: CreateStairs
description: Creates Stair elements based on the given baseline and parameters, optionally with the segment type of each baseline edge and the turn at each baseline point (landings and winders). Accepts the same settings as ModifyStairs: the step values with their locks, the finish and structure visibility, the extra treads, the walking line, the numbering, the walking direction, and the tread, riser and structure settings of the flights and the landings; settings not given come from the Stair tool defaults or the favorite.

name: CreateSurfaces
description: Creates or overwrites Surface attributes based on the given parameters.

name: CreateTexts
description: Creates standalone Text elements based on the given parameters.

name: CreateViewMapFolder
description: Creates a new folder in the View Map.

name: CreateViewsInViewMap
description: Creates independent (non-clone) navigator views in a specified View Map folder, by copying database and settings from source items.

name: CreateWallThicknessDimensions
description: Creates associative wall thickness dimensions for the given walls.

name: CreateWalls
description: Creates Wall elements based on the given parameters. Takes the same wall settings as ModifyWalls, applied by the same code, except geometryType and profileType, which the new wall takes from the favorite or the Wall tool defaults (its plan outline is always Straight), and bottomOffset, which comes from zCoordinate. Neither command can write a Polygonal outline (it needs an outline polygon, which these commands do not take), connectionPriority or junctionSequence (Archicad ignores writes to them; GetDetailsOfElements reads them), and on Archicad 29 any story visibility other than 'Home story only' and 'All relevant stories'.

name: CreateWindows
description: Creates Window elements in host walls based on the given parameters.

name: CreateWorksheetMarkers
description: Places Worksheet markers with their clip polygon in the current floor plan, section or elevation, each with a new Worksheet viewpoint, like the Worksheet tool. GetDetailsOfElements reads them back.

name: CreateWorksheets
description: Creates independent Worksheet databases. Returns the databaseId and the Project Map navigatorItemId of each new worksheet.

name: CreateZoneCategories
description: Creates or overwrites Zone Category attributes based on the given parameters.

name: CreateZones
description: Creates Zone elements based on the given parameters. Takes the same zone settings as ModifyZones (name, number, category, zone stamp, levels, contour line and cover fill), applied by the same helpers; the polygon or reference point is only set here. An item whose area would overlap an existing Zone on the same story fails with an error naming that Zone instead of opening Archicad's modal overlap warning, unless its allowOverlap is true.

name: DeactivateDesignOptionsInCombinations
description: Turns off the given design options in the given combinations, leaving their other options as they are. Available from Archicad 29.

name: DeleteAnalyticalLoadCases
description: Deletes the given structural analysis load cases in one undo step.

name: DeleteAnalyticalLoadCombinations
description: Deletes the given structural analysis load combinations in one undo step.

name: DeleteAnalyticalLoadGroups
description: Deletes the given structural analysis load groups in one undo step.

name: DeleteAndReplaceAttributes
description: Deletes fills, line types, surfaces or building materials and replaces each by another attribute of the same type wherever it was used, like Delete and Replace in the Attribute Manager. Every reference is rewritten to the replacement, the way ReindexAttributes rewrites them: the fields of the elements in the floor plan and in every view and layout, the parameters of library part based elements, their memo data, the tool defaults, the Favorites, the other attributes that refer to it (composites, building materials, surfaces, profiles, MEP systems) and the graphic override rules. Elements on a hidden or locked layer are changed too: their layers are shown and unlocked for the change and put back afterwards (in the current window). If an element cannot be changed (it is locked itself, or not reserved in Teamwork), everything is put back and that attribute is not deleted. Elements from hotlinked modules cannot be changed and are listed. Indices typed into GDL scripts are not found, and the frame and panel classes of curtain wall Favorites and of the Curtain Wall tool default keep the deleted attribute (named in the warnings). If a tool default, Favorite, attribute or rule cannot be rewritten to the replacement, it keeps a copy of the deleted attribute with its name and a new attribute id, named in the warnings. The whole call is one undo step. With dryRun true nothing is changed and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and each attribute that passes the checks gets wouldDelete and lists every reference a real run would rewrite (elements, tool defaults, Favorites, other attributes, graphic override rules, elements from hotlinked modules). Available from Archicad 27.

name: DeleteAttributeFolders
description: Deletes attribute folders, each given by attribute type and path, together with all the subfolders and deletable attributes they contain (a folder holding an attribute that cannot be deleted is kept). The root folder cannot be deleted. With dryRun true nothing is deleted: the response has dryRun set to true, and each folder that exists and is not the root folder gets wouldDelete. Available from Archicad 26.

name: DeleteAttributes
description: Deletes the given attributes. Returns an execution result for each input item. With dryRun true nothing is deleted: the response has dryRun set to true, and each attribute that passes the checks made before deleting (valid attribute type, attribute exists) gets wouldDelete.

name: DeleteClassificationItems
description: Deletes the given Classification Items. With dryRun true nothing is deleted and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and each classification item that exists gets wouldDelete.

name: DeleteClassificationSystems
description: Deletes the given Classification Systems. With dryRun true nothing is deleted and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and each classification system that exists gets wouldDelete.

name: DeleteDesignOptionCombinations
description: Deletes the given design option combinations. Available from Archicad 29.

name: DeleteDesignOptionSets
description: Deletes the given design option sets. Available from Archicad 29.

name: DeleteDesignOptions
description: Deletes the given design options. Available from Archicad 29.

name: DeleteElectricalCircuits
description: Removes electrical circuits from their panels. Available from Archicad 30.

name: DeleteElementSets
description: Deletes the given element sets. The elements of a set are not deleted. Only element sets created by the Tapir Add-On can be deleted; sets created by other add-ons are reported as failed. With dryRun true nothing is deleted and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and each element set that a real run would delete gets wouldDelete.

name: DeleteElements
description: Deletes elements. The zones of the call are deleted before all the other elements, so an automatic zone deleted together with its bounding walls is gone before its boundary is; deleting the boundary of an automatic zone without the zone itself can open Archicad's modal 'No closed polygon found' dialog, which blocks the command until someone clicks it in Archicad. Returns an execution result for each input element: an element that could not be deleted (for example because its layer is locked) or a guid that is not in the project gets a failed execution result instead of being skipped silently, and does not stop the other elements from being deleted. With dryRun true nothing is deleted and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and each element that passes the checks made before deleting gets wouldDelete, so a script can preview a deletion before making it.

name: DeleteEmbeddedLibraryItems
description: Deletes the given items from the embedded library. The path of an item is the same relative path that AddFilesToEmbeddedLibrary takes as outputPath. Available from Archicad 27.

name: DeleteFavoriteFolder
description: Deletes a folder of the Favorites palette given by its path. Archicad deletes the folder's Favorites and subfolders with it, so a folder that is not empty is deleted only if recursive is true. The root folder cannot be deleted. Returns the deleted folder. Available from Archicad 29.

name: DeleteFavorites
description: Delete existing favorites.

name: DeleteFavoritesWithManager
description: Deletes the given Favorites through the Favorite manager, each found by name, optionally only in the given folder. One execution result for each. Available from Archicad 29.

name: DeleteGhostRecords
description: Deletes the trace (ghost) record of each given parent database, which removes the trace reference shown in that database's window. A database without a trace reference gets a failed execution result. Not undoable.

name: DeleteGraphicOverrideCombinations
description: Deletes graphic override combinations. Their rules are kept. Available from Archicad 27.

name: DeleteGraphicOverrideRuleGroups
description: Deletes graphic override rule groups, found by name. A group that still contains rules is kept unless its rules are moved to another group or deleted with it. Available from Archicad 27.

name: DeleteGraphicOverrideRules
description: Deletes graphic override rules. They are also removed from the combinations that contain them. Available from Archicad 27.

name: DeleteHotlinkNodes
description: Deletes hotlink nodes together with their placed instances, as the Hotlink Manager's Delete does.

name: DeleteIssue
description: Deletes the specified issue. With dryRun true nothing is deleted and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and wouldDelete when the issue exists.

name: DeleteKeynoteFolders
description: Deletes the given keynote folders including their content. Available from Archicad 28.

name: DeleteKeynoteItems
description: Deletes the given keynote items. Available from Archicad 28.

name: DeleteMEPPhysicalSystems
description: Removes MEP physical systems from their system groups. Their member elements are not deleted. Available from Archicad 29.

name: DeleteMEPPreferenceTableRows
description: Deletes rows of a segment, branch, elbow or (from Archicad 29) transition preference table by their key (the reference ids and, for branch and elbow rows from Archicad 29, the angle), in one undo step. The rows of segment tables, and of the elbow tables of Archicad 28, are emptied instead. On Archicad 27 a row is found by its shape and index. Available from Archicad 27.

name: DeleteModulData
description: Deletes the module data with the given names. Deleting module data is not an undoable step.

name: DeleteNavigatorItems
description: Deletes navigator items from the navigator tree: views and folders of the View Map, layouts and master layouts of the Layout Book, and independent worksheets and details of the Project Map. Layout subsets, View Map folders that are not empty, the other Project Map items and marker-linked worksheets and details cannot be deleted; the failed execution result says which case applies. An item that Archicad refuses to delete (in a Teamwork project: it is not reserved or the user has no right to delete it) is reported as a failed execution result. dryRun reports the result of the checks made before deleting (item not found, layout subset, View Map folder that is not empty) without deleting anything.

name: DeleteProjectData
description: Deletes the project data with the given names.

name: DeleteProjectInfoFields
description: Deletes one or more custom project info fields, by their autotext keys or, from Archicad 30, by the ids of the fields of the Project Info groups. Hardcoded fields cannot be deleted.

name: DeleteProjectInfoGroups
description: Deletes Project Info groups. A group that contains fixed (built-in) fields cannot be deleted. Available from Archicad 30.

name: DeletePropertyDefinitions
description: Deletes the given Custom Property Definitions. With dryRun true nothing is deleted and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and each property that exists gets wouldDelete.

name: DeletePropertyGroups
description: Deletes the given Custom Property Groups. With dryRun true nothing is deleted and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and each property group that exists gets wouldDelete.

name: DeleteSelectedElements
description: Deletes the currently selected elements in one undo step, the same as pressing the Delete key. With dryRun true nothing is deleted and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true and lists the selected elements, with wouldDelete when there is at least one, or fails when one of them cannot be edited (Archicad then deletes none of them).

name: DeleteUserDataOfAttributes
description: Removes the user data of attributes, every key at once. Archicad does not record this change as an undo step, so Undo does not revert it. With dryRun true nothing is removed: the response has dryRun set to true, and each attribute that exists gets wouldDelete.

name: DeleteUserDataOfElements
description: Deletes the user data this add-on stored on the given elements. Archicad keeps the user data of an element per add-on, so the data of other add-ons is left as it is. All deletions are one undo step. The output has one execution result per element, aligned with the input array of elements. With dryRun true nothing is deleted and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and each element that exists gets wouldDelete.

name: DeselectAll
description: Clears the selection in the current window.

name: DetachElementsFromIssue
description: Detaches elements from the specified issue.

name: DistributeElements
description: Distributes 3 or more elements on the floor plan or in the current 2D view evenly along X (horizontal) or Y (vertical), with equal distances between the middles of their plan bounding boxes (centers) or equal space between the boxes (gaps), by moving them in one undo step. The elements are taken in the order of their middles along the direction, and the two outermost stay where they are. The bounding boxes are those Get2DBoundingBoxes returns. Supported types: Wall, Column, Beam, Slab, Roof, Shell, Morph, Mesh, Zone, Object, Lamp, Stair, Railing, CurtainWall, Line, PolyLine, Arc, Circle, Spline, Hatch, Text and Hotspot. An element of another type (doors, windows and openings, which only slide along their host, subelements, dimensions, labels, ...) or one that cannot be edited gets a failed execution result naming the reason, and the other elements are still distributed.

name: DuplicateDesignOptionCombinations
description: Duplicates the given design option combinations and returns the identifiers of the new combinations. Available from Archicad 29.

name: EditHierarchicalElement
description: Opens the given hierarchical element (Curtain Wall, Stair, Railing, Beam or Column) in its hierarchical 3D editing mode, as the Edit button of the element does. Fails when Archicad is already in an editing mode. Limitation: while the editing mode is open, Archicad refuses every JSON command, this add-on's included, with error 4001 (ongoing user input), FinishHierarchicalEditing included, so the mode can only be left in Archicad, with the button of its edit mode palette (reported for Archicad 29). Requires Archicad 27 or later.

name: ElevateElements
description: Moves elements vertically by a given offset in meters, like Edit > Move > Elevate. An element that cannot be edited (its layer is hidden or locked, it is locked, or it is not available in teamwork) gets a failed execution result naming the reason instead of being skipped silently.

name: ExportFavorites
description: Export the project's Favorites to a .prefs file or folder. From Archicad 29 they can also be exported to a folder of Favorite files (xml format) or to a legacy .prf file (legacyPRF format). With overwrite false an export to a single file refuses to replace an existing file.

name: ExportIssuesToBCF
description: Exports specified issues to a BCF file. With overwrite false it refuses to replace an existing file.

name: FilterElements
description: Keeps the elements that match all the given criteria: Archicad's flag filters (filters), layer (layerIndices), home story (floorIndices), element type (elementTypes) and hotlink (fromHotlink, hotlinkIds). Within one criterion any of the listed values matches; an omitted criterion does not filter.

name: FindDimensionStandard
description: Finds a dimension standard (Options > Project Preferences > Dimensions) by its name and returns its index, name and guid. Available from Archicad 27.

name: FindLibraryParts
description: Finds loaded library parts with the Library Manager: all of them, GDL objects, images or text files, optionally only those whose name contains a text. Returns the name, path and index of each. Available from Archicad 28.

name: FindModelViewOption
description: Finds a model view option combination by id or by name and returns its index, id, name and flags. The index is the one SetViewOptions takes to switch the model view options of a window to the combination. Available from Archicad 27.

name: FinishHierarchicalEditing
description: Finishes the current hierarchical editing mode (Curtain Wall, Stair, Railing, Beam or Column): accept true keeps the changes (OK), accept false discards them (Cancel). The accept parameter is required, so changes are never discarded silently. Fails when Archicad is not in such an editing mode. Limitation: while an editing mode is open, Archicad refuses JSON commands with error 4001 (ongoing user input) before they run, so this command cannot leave a mode opened by EditHierarchicalElement or in Archicad (reported for Archicad 29); leave it in Archicad instead. Requires Archicad 27 or later.

name: FitInWindow
description: Zooms to the given elements or fits everything in the window.

name: GenerateDocumentation
description: Generates files for the documentation. Used by Tapir developers only.

name: Get2DBoundingBoxes
description: Get the 2D bounding box of elements as Archicad draws them, in the coordinates of the database the element is in: the floor plan, a section, a worksheet, a layout or a master layout. Works for 2D elements (Line, PolyLine, Arc, Hatch, Text, Label, Dimension, Drawing ...) as well as for model elements; a Text's box covers its drawn lines, a Drawing's box its frame with the title. The current window does not need to show the element. The output is the array of the bounding boxes respective to the input array of elements.

name: Get3DBoundingBoxes
description: Get the 3D bounding box of elements. The bounding box is calculated from the global origin in the 3D view. The output is the array of the bounding boxes respective to the input array of elements. An element without 3D geometry of its own gets an error item instead of a bounding box. Walls, Slabs, Roofs, Zones and Stairs are measured on their 3D model, so the box of a Wall includes its connections to other walls. The current window does not need to show the element: it works with a layout or a section open as well.

name: Get3DCutPlanes
description: Gets whether the 3D cut planes are on and the cut planes (pa, pb, pc, pd) of the 3D window, in the form accepted by Set3DCutPlanes.

name: Get3DCutawayStatus
description: Returns whether 3D Cutaway is on and whether the cutting planes are shown in the 3D window. In Archicad 25-27 the 3D window may need to be open.

name: Get3DDocumentSettings
description: Gets the settings of a 3D Document, given by its navigator item: the element and story filter, the 3D cut, the projection, the window and zoom, the uniform cut and uncut surface attributes, the source and the boundary contours, with the field names of API_DocumentFrom3DType.

name: Get3DFilterAndCutSettings
description: Gets the 'Filter and Cut Elements in 3D' settings of the 3D window: the stories shown, the filter mode and which element types are shown. Available from Archicad 27.

name: Get3DGeometryOfElements
description: Gets the 3D geometry of elements as the solid bodies of their 3D model: a vertex list in world coordinates and the planar faces (with their holes) referencing it, each face with its surface attribute when that is a project attribute. The bodies of the subelements of a Stair, Railing or Curtain Wall, and of the segments of a Column or Beam, are included. The output is aligned with the input array of elements. The 3D model of the elements is generated as needed, so many elements can take a while.

name: Get3DModelCounts
description: Gets the number of components of each type (bodies, polygons, polygon edges, edges, vertices, normal vectors, materials and lights) in the 3D model Archicad currently holds. Bodies, materials and lights are counted with ACAPI_ModelAccess_GetNum; the polygons, polygon edges, edges, vertices and normal vectors, which that function refuses to count, are summed over the bodies. A type that cannot be counted gets an error item. Available from Archicad 27.

name: Get3DProjectionSettings
description: Gets the 3D projection settings of the 3D window: whether it is perspective or axonometric, the camera and target position, view cone, roll angle, distance and azimuth of a perspective, or the projection type, azimuth and transformation matrix of an axonometry, and the sun position of either (date and time or azimuth and altitude).

name: Get3DStyleDetails
description: Gets the settings of 3D styles by name (an empty name or no names means the current 3D style): rendering engine, model type, monochrome and background colors, contours, shadows and hatching. Available from Archicad 27.

name: Get3DStyles
description: Gets the names of the 3D styles of the project and the name of the current one, which the 3D window uses.

name: Get3DWindowSettings
description: Gets the 3D window settings: the pixel size of the 3D window and the zoom (scale and displacement) of its projection.

name: GetActiveGraphicalOverrideCombination
description: Gets the graphic override combination applied to the current window, with its id and name. The response is empty when no combination is applied. This is the combination of the window itself, not the one stored in a saved view (see GetViewSettings). Available from Archicad 30.

name: GetAddOnVersion
description: Retrieves the version of the Tapir Additional JSON Commands Add-On.

name: GetAddOnViewpointChildren
description: Returns the direct children of an add-on viewpoint root or group. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetAddOnViewpointRoots
description: Returns the roots of the add-on viewpoints: the Project Map items created through the Archicad API by an add-on, as Archicad lists them to Tapir. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetAddOnViewpoints
description: Returns the details of the given add-on viewpoint items: their parent, type (Root, Group or Leaf), ID, name, view settings flags and attached data (base64 encoded). The output is aligned with the input array; an item that cannot be read gets an error. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetAllAutoTextKeys
description: Retrieves every autotext key Archicad knows (not only the property-based ones returned by GetAutoTextKeys) with its current value, resolved without an element context.

name: GetAllClassificationSystems
description: Returns the classification systems of the project with their guid, name, description, source, version and date. Same output as the official GetAllClassificationSystems command, so scripts can rely on Tapir commands only.

name: GetAllElements
description: Returns the identifier of all elements on the plan. Use the optional filter parameter for filtering. Objects that belong to another element (zone stamps, the parts of stairs and railings) are left out unless the IncludeSubElemObjects filter is given.

name: GetAllElementsOfGroups
description: Gets all the elements of each given group, including the elements of its nested groups.

name: GetAllFavorites
description: Returns every Favorite of the project, or only those of the given element type, with its name and element type. Available from Archicad 29.

name: GetAllProperties
description: Returns all user defined and built-in properties. Optionally only the given properties or property types, and without the availability lists.

name: GetAnalyticalLinks
description: Retrieves the settings, the connected member parts and the geometry of the given analytical links. Available from Archicad 26.

name: GetAnalyticalLoadCases
description: Retrieves the structural analysis load cases of the given load group, or of the project when no load group is given, with all their fields.

name: GetAnalyticalLoadCombinations
description: Retrieves the structural analysis load combinations of the project with all their fields and load factors.

name: GetAnalyticalLoadGroups
description: Retrieves the structural analysis load groups of the project with all their fields.

name: GetAnalyticalLoads
description: Retrieves the settings, the loaded member part, the custom data (the curve of an edge load, the contour of a surface load) and the geometry of the given analytical point, edge and surface loads. Available from Archicad 26.

name: GetAnalyticalMemberDetails
description: Retrieves the curve, surface or segmented surface member of the given elements in a Structural Analytical Model, with their connections. Cross sections, curves, nodes and surfaces are returned with every field the Archicad version has.

name: GetAnalyticalMemberPartGeometries
description: Retrieves the node of the given analytical member vertices and the curve of the given member edges. Available from Archicad 26.

name: GetAnalyticalMemberTypesOfElements
description: Retrieves the analytical member type (Beam, Column, Roof, Slab, Wall or Unknown) of the given elements.

name: GetAnalyticalMembers
description: Lists the elements of the curve and surface members of the given Structural Analytical Model, or of the model of the current view when no model is given (the model is required before Archicad 27).

name: GetAnalyticalModel
description: Retrieves the Structural Analytical Model of the given variation, as returned by GetAnalyticalModelVariation.

name: GetAnalyticalModelCheckTypeId
description: Retrieves the type identifier of the Structural Analytical Model check. Available from Archicad 29.

name: GetAnalyticalModelVariation
description: Retrieves the variation of the given Structural Analytical Model, or of the model of the current view when no model is given (the model is required before Archicad 27). The fields of the variation depend on the Archicad version.

name: GetAnalyticalReleases
description: Retrieves the releases of the given analytical members. Available from Archicad 26.

name: GetAnalyticalSupports
description: Retrieves the settings, the supported member part and the geometry of the given analytical supports. Available from Archicad 26.

name: GetAnalyticalVisibilitySettings
description: Retrieves the visibility settings of the Structural Analytical Model. Available from Archicad 26.

name: GetArcFromUser
description: Asks the designer to draw an arc in the current window - its center, its start point (which sets the radius) and its end point - with a rubber-band circle shown while drawing, and returns its center, radius, start and end angles, the angle it turns through, its direction and its start and end points. Archicad waits for the clicks or for Escape, and every other JSON command queues behind this one until then; cancelling returns cancelled.

name: GetArchicadLicenseInfo
description: Retrieves the license the running Archicad runs on: its type (Full, Education, Trial, Demo, Start or BIMcloud Team Client), the raw protection mode with its bits by name, and the highest Software Service Agreement (SSA) level of the license, so a script can warn before it uses a feature the license lacks. The SSA level is not available in Archicad 25.

name: GetArchicadLocation
description: Retrieves the location of the currently running Archicad executable.

name: GetArchicadReleaseInfo
description: Retrieves the main version, release version and build number of the running Archicad, with the caption of its window.

name: GetArchicadVisibility
description: Returns whether the Archicad application is shown or hidden. Supported on Windows only; on macOS it returns an error.

name: GetAttributeIndexes
description: Reports for each given attribute type how many attributes there are, the first valid and the highest index in use, and the free indexes between them (for example those of deleted attributes). Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetAttributesByType
description: Returns the details of every attribute of the given type, including the path of the attribute folder holding it (Archicad 26 and newer). From Archicad 30 an attribute that Archicad keeps a creation record of also carries creationInfo: how (method), from where (source), by whom and when it was created.

name: GetAttributesFromProject
description: Reads the attributes of the given types from another project or template file without opening it, for example to compare them with the attributes of the open project. Nothing is imported into the open project. The names are the legacy 8-bit names, so non-ASCII characters may not come through. Archicad does not read Layer, Surface, BuildingMaterial and MEPSystem attributes from a file that is not open: these types get an error item instead of an empty list. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetAutoGroupMode
description: Gets the current state of the Auto Group mode.

name: GetAutoIntersect
description: Gets whether Auto-Intersection (Options > Auto-Intersection) is on. It changes what the wall and beam creation commands produce: with it on, the new elements are joined at their intersections.

name: GetAutoTextKeys
description: Retrieves the available autotext keys (name and embeddable key): the Project Info, layout, drawing, date and other autotexts Archicad lists, and the property based ones, optionally for a specific element. Embed a key in a Text or Label content by surrounding it with '<' and '>'.

name: GetAutoTextName
description: Retrieves the display names of one or more autotext keys (as returned inside a '<...>' embedded key), with a direct guid lookup for property-based keys instead of enumerating every property definition.

name: GetAvailableLibraryParts
description: Lists library parts currently available to the project. Filter by typeId (e.g. 'Door', 'Window', 'Object', 'Lamp').

name: GetBodyMaterialsOfElements
description: Gets the building material of each body of the 3D model of the given elements. The 3D model is generated with separate components in a temporary sight, so a composite structure has one body per skin and the 3D window is not changed. The output is aligned with the input array of elements. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetBuildingMaterialPhysicalProperties
description: Retrieves the physical properties of the given Building Materials.

name: GetBuildingMaterials
description: Returns the details of the given Building Material attributes.

name: GetCalculatedParametersOfCurtainWallSubElements
description: Gets the GDL parameters (name, type, value) of the given Curtain Wall Frame, Panel, Junction and Accessory elements as Archicad calculated them for their place in the curtain wall. GetGDLParametersOfElements returns the parameters the sub-element was set up with instead.

name: GetCalculationUnits
description: Gets the project calculation units.

name: GetCameras
description: Gets the Camera Sets (camera paths) of the project with their name, whether the set is the active one, its current camera, and its cameras in path order. Each camera has its element id, whether it is active in the path, and its perspective: camera and target position, distance, azimuth, view cone, roll angle, two-point perspective and sun, in the shape Set3DProjectionSettings accepts, so passing a camera's perspective there shows its view in the 3D window. Archicad cameras are always perspective; they have no name of their own.

name: GetCategoryValuesOfDefaults
description: Gets the category values (Structural Function, Position, Renovation Status ...) of the tool defaults of the given element types, the values new elements of the type get, optionally only for the given category types. A category the default has no value in is listed without categoryValueId; an element type without any of the requested categories gets an error item. The names are localized: use the type and the categoryValueId in scripts.

name: GetCategoryValuesOfElements
description: Gets the category values (Structural Function, Position, Renovation Status ...) of the given elements, optionally only for the given category types. An element that has none of the requested categories (an annotation, for example) gets an error item. The names are localized: use the type and the categoryValueId in scripts.

name: GetClassificationItemParents
description: Returns the parent item and the classification system of the given Classification Items; a top level item has no parent. The output is aligned with the input array of items.

name: GetClassificationItemVisibility
description: Tells whether the given classification items are visible (offered) for the given elements, element tool defaults and attributes, such as building materials. Non-existing targets and classification items are reported as errors. Visibility does not tell whether the target is classified with the item, and an item can be visible even if its parent item is not.

name: GetClassificationOfAttributesInSystem
description: Returns the classification of the given attributes (for example Building Materials) in the given classification system. classificationItemId is omitted for an unclassified attribute.

name: GetClassificationsOfAttributes
description: Returns the classifications of the given attributes (building materials, composites, surfaces, etc.) in every classification system they are classified in.

name: GetClassificationsOfElementDefaults
description: Returns the classification of the tool defaults (the settings new elements get) of the given element types in the given classification systems.

name: GetClassificationsOfElements
description: Returns the classification of the given elements in the given classification systems. It works for subelements of hierarchal elements also.

name: GetClassificationsOfToolDefaults
description: Returns every classification of the tool defaults (the settings new elements get) of the given element types, in all classification systems at once. Unlike GetClassificationsOfElementDefaults it needs no list of classification systems; systems in which a default is unclassified are left out.

name: GetCollisions
description: Detect collisions between the given two groups of elements.

name: GetCommands
description: Retrieves every command of the Tapir Add-On with its command group, the Tapir version it was introduced in and its description, so a script can check that a command exists before calling it.

name: GetCommentsFromIssue
description: Retrieves comments information from the specified issue.

name: GetComponentsOfElements
description: Returns the components of the elements: the building material skins of composite walls, slabs, roofs and shells, and the parts of complex profile walls, beams and columns. The components have their own property values (building material, thickness, area, volume and the properties of the building material); read them with GetPropertyValuesOfElementComponents.

name: GetComposites
description: Returns the details of the given Composite attributes.

name: GetConnectedElements
description: Gets the elements hosted by (connected to) the given owner elements, filtered to the given element type: for example the Windows or Doors of a Wall, the frames, panels, junctions and accessories of a Curtain Wall, the risers, treads and structures of a Stair, or the posts, rails and panels of a Railing.

name: GetContainingDatabases
description: Returns the database (window type, database id and name) that contains each of the given elements, from any database, not only the current one. Pass the windowType and databaseId to ChangeWindow to open it, for example to find an element placed on a layout.

name: GetCoordinateOrigins
description: Gets the offset of the virtual coordinate system origin from the world origin, and the user origin of the current database. Use it to tell which origin the coordinates of different sources (elements, views, survey point) are relative to.

name: GetCurrentAnalyticalModel
description: Retrieves the Structural Analytical Model created for the current view. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetCurrentLayerCombination
description: Returns the layer combination in effect in the current window. No layer combination is returned when the current state of the layers matches none.

name: GetCurrentPenTable
description: Returns the current Pen Table (its index, attribute identifier and name) and its number of pens. Pass the returned attributeId to GetPenTables to read the pens.

name: GetCurrentRevisionChangesOfLayouts
description: Retrieves all changes belong to the last revision of the given layouts.

name: GetCurrentTool
description: Returns the tool active in the Toolbox: its element type, its variation (the subtype, e.g. Door, Skylight or a library part subtype of an add-on) and, for the tools of add-ons, its class id, in the form SetCurrentTool accepts. Nothing is returned when the active tool makes no element, e.g. the Arrow or the Marquee.

name: GetCurrentViewImage
description: Returns what the 3D window, or the PhotoRendering window, shows as a base64 encoded png or jpg image with its size in pixels, without writing a file. Available from Archicad 30.

name: GetCurrentWindowDrawingScale
description: Returns the drawing scale of the current (active) window, the scale shown in the bottom bar, as its denominator: 100.0 for 1:100, 20.0 for 1:20. Unlike GetViewSettings it needs no saved view. It reads the scale of the current database: the floor plan, a section, elevation, interior elevation, detail, worksheet or 3D document window, each of which has its own. Layouts always return 1.0.

name: GetCurrentWindowType
description: Returns the type of the current (active) window and, when it has one, the databaseId of the database it shows, which ChangeWindow takes to bring the window back after a script switched to another one. The saved view (View Map item) the window was opened from is not returned, as Archicad does not tell which one it was.

name: GetCurtainWallAbsoluteBottoms
description: Gets the absolute bottom level of curtain walls or their subelements (segments, frames, panels, junctions, accessories). The output is aligned with the input array of elements.

name: GetCustomCurveMemberStretch
description: Retrieves the lengths added to the start and end of the given curve members. Available from Archicad 29.

name: GetCutPolygonsOfElements
description: Cuts each body of the 3D model of the given elements with a plane and returns, for each body, its building material, the area of the cut surface and its polygons (outline and holes) in 2D coordinates of the plane. From Archicad 28 the 3D model is generated with separate components in a temporary sight, so a composite structure has one body per skin and the 3D window is not changed. Before Archicad 28 the bodies are those of the element's 3D model (a composite structure is one body) and their building materials are left out. The output is aligned with the input array of elements.

name: GetDatabaseIdFromNavigatorItemId
description: Gets the ID of the database associated with the supplied navigator item id

name: GetDatabases
description: Lists every database of the given types (sections, elevations, interior elevations, details, worksheets, 3D documents, layouts, master layouts) with its database ID, name and reference ID, without walking the navigator trees.

name: GetDescriptorsOfElements
description: Gets the descriptors of the given elements: the listing descriptors in the property objects of each element, with the library part that declares them (index, name and guid), their listing database set and index, and their status (Normal, Deleted or Local). The output is aligned with the input array of elements.

name: GetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews
description: Retrieves which design option combination the given views show: only the main model, a combination, a custom set of design options or a deleted combination. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetDesignOptionCombinations
description: Retrieves information about existing design option combinations.

name: GetDesignOptionForElements
description: Retrieves the design option association for the specified elements. Available from Archicad 29.

name: GetDesignOptionSets
description: Retrieves information about existing design option sets, and in Teamwork projects the Teamwork identifier of the design options. Available from Archicad 29.

name: GetDesignOptions
description: Retrieves information about existing design options. Available from Archicad 29.

name: GetDetailsOfElements
description: Gets the details of elements (geometry parameters etc). When elements is omitted, all elements matching the optional server-side filter (types, floorIndices, layerIndices) are queried; an empty elements list returns no details. Use the optional fields parameter to return only the fields you need (e.g. elementId, type, id, floorIndex) and skip the computation of the others (for example floorPlanPolygons). Use the optional additionalFields parameter to also get the info string, the compound info string, the library part unique ID and the creator tool unique ID. An element of another database (a layout, a section, a worksheet ...) returns only its header fields (type, floor index, layer, draw index) with fromOtherDatabase set to true.

name: GetDialogAutoClose
description: Tells whether the dialog auto close is on, the same state SetDialogAutoClose writes, so a script can restore it afterwards. The state belongs to the running Archicad process: it is off when Archicad starts (unless the TAPIR_DIALOG_AUTOCLOSE environment variable is true), it stays as last set until Archicad quits, and it is shared by every add-on and script in that Archicad.

name: GetDimensionData
description: Gets the data of existing dimension chains: the line pen, the marker type and pen and the default witness line, and per witness point the coordinates, measured value, witness line and the text height, pen and frame.

name: GetDimensionStandards
description: Gets the dimension standards of the project (Options > Project Preferences > Dimensions) with their name and the unit, decimals and rounding of each dimension type, optionally only the one with the given name. Read-only. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetDocumentFrom3DDefaults
description: Gets the defaults a newly created 3D Document starts with: name, reference ID, vectorial hatching and sun shadows, transparency, connection to the model, surfaces, boundary contours and the uniform cut, uncut, shadow and hidden edge attributes.

name: GetDocumentRevisions
description: Retrieves all document revisions.

name: GetDrawingContentBoxes
description: Returns the full content box of the given Drawing elements, independent of their frames, as ACAPI_Drawing_GetFullDrawingContentBox reports it. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetDrawingNumberingGridLines
description: Gets the lines of the grid of the grid-based drawing numbering of the current layout (start and end point, pen index, line type index), for example to find which grid cell a drawing on the layout sits in. The current window must be a layout (see ChangeWindow), and only a layout that uses grid-based drawing numbering has such a grid.

name: GetDrawingPrimitivesOfElements
description: Returns the 2D drawing primitives (points, lines, arcs, texts, polylines, triangles, polygons, pictures) Archicad draws each given floor plan element from, in drawing order, as ACAPI_DrawingPrimitive_ShapePrimsExt decomposes it on every story and unclipped. Control items (type Ctrl_*) mark the beginning and the end of sub-parts such as hatches and texts. Texts are returned without their content and polylines without their vertices. A Ctrl_ElementRef item names the element it refers to: the drawing of a Wall ends with one for each Window and Door in it, while Windows and Doors give no primitives of their own. The floor plan must be the current database. The output is aligned with the input array of elements.

name: GetEditModeState
description: Tells whether Archicad is in a hierarchical editing mode (curtain wall, stair, beam or column editing), and which element is being edited. Read only: it never enters, leaves or cancels an editing mode. Commands that modify the project can fail while such a mode is active. The overall inEditMode flag requires Archicad 29 or later; the command requires Archicad 27 or later.

name: GetElectricalCircuits
description: Gets the given electrical circuits, the circuits of the given panels, or every circuit of the project: name, description, owner panel, connected devices and panels, voltage, phases, wiring type, loads, voltage drop and estimated cable length. Available from Archicad 30.
