name: GetElectricalDevices
description: Gets the electrical devices (lights, sockets and other consumers) of the project or the given ones: parent circuit, placement, apparent power, load classification, demand load and directly connected MEP elements. Available from Archicad 30.

name: GetElectricalPanels
description: Gets the electrical panels (distribution boards) of the project or the given ones: name, circuit naming, circuits, parent circuit, placement and the connected and demand loads in total and per phase. Available from Archicad 30.

name: GetElectricalProjectSettings
description: Gets the electrical project settings: the default voltage, the wiring types with their cross-sectional area and the load classifications with their demand factor. Available from Archicad 30.

name: GetElementAtCoordinate
description: Finds the element of the given polygonal type (for example Slab, Roof, Mesh, Zone or Hatch) at a coordinate of the floor plan of the current database, the way a click there would. Use the optional filters parameter (the values of FilterElements) to consider only, for example, the elements visible by layer, and the optional z parameter to give the elevation of the point. Returns found: false when there is no such element. Useful together with GetPointFromUser.

name: GetElementCategories
description: Lists the element categories of the project (Structural Function, Position, Renovation Status, Renovation Filter and, in the German version, BRI) with their possible values. The names of the categories and values are localized: identify a category by its type and a value by its categoryValueId, never by name.

name: GetElementChangesSince
description: Returns the new, modified and deleted elements between a state captured by CaptureElementState and either another captured state (toStateId) or the current state of the project. Scripts that keep an external copy of the model use it to sync only what changed instead of re-reading every element. The changes come from Archicad's element difference generator, which tracks the model elements: 2D elements such as texts, labels and hatches can be missing from the lists, so read those directly. Fails for a stateId that is unknown - never captured, released, or lost because the project was closed or Archicad restarted.

name: GetElementConnections
description: Gets the connections among the given elements: each pair of touching elements once, with the polygons of the surface where they touch, in world coordinates. The 3D model of the elements is generated with separate components in a temporary sight, so the 3D window is not changed. Also returns, aligned with the input array of elements, whether each element was found. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetElementFromUser
description: Asks the designer to click an element in the current window and returns its id, its type and the clicked point. A click on empty space or on an element of a type not asked for asks again. Archicad waits for the click or for Escape, and every other JSON command queues behind this one until then; cancelling returns cancelled.

name: GetElementPreviewImage
description: Returns the preview image of the given element.

name: GetElementSetData
description: Gets the elements and the custom data of each given element set. Element sets are created by add-ons to link elements together; the custom data is returned as Base64 encoded bytes.

name: GetElementSetsOfElements
description: Gets the element sets that contain each given element. Only element sets created by the Tapir Add-On are examined; sets created by other add-ons are not found.

name: GetElementTrims
description: Which roofs and shells trim each queried element, with the trim type, and which elements it trims.

name: GetElementTypeNames
description: Gets the localized names of the given element types, as the running Archicad shows them (for example 'Wand' for Wall in German Archicad). The output is aligned with the input array of element types. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetElementUserData
description: Reads the values stored on elements by SetElementUserData: every key of each element, or only the given keys.

name: GetElementsAttachedToIssue
description: Retrieves attached elements of the specified issue, filtered by attachment type.

name: GetElementsByClassification
description: Returns the elements classified with the given classification items, one list per item, so elements can be filtered by classification in a single call.

name: GetElementsByCriteria
description: Returns the elements, or with countOnly only their number, that match all the given criteria: element types, home stories, layers, Archicad's element filter flags and property criteria (a value compared in internal units, or a value status such as hasValue, isUserUndefined, isNotAvailable, isDefault or hasCustomValue). An unknown type, property or operator is an error, not ignored. Objects that belong to another element (zone stamps, the parts of stairs and railings) are left out unless the IncludeSubElemObjects filter is given.

name: GetElementsByIFCIds
description: Retrieves the elements by the given IFC identifiers. Accepts IFC GlobalIds in every Archicad version.

name: GetElementsByType
description: Returns the identifier of every element of the given type on the plan. It works for any type. Use the optional filter parameter for filtering. Objects that belong to another element (zone stamps, the parts of stairs and railings) are left out unless the IncludeSubElemObjects filter is given.

name: GetElementsInCreationOrder
description: Returns the identifier of every element of the current database, or of the given databases, in the order the elements were created.

name: GetElementsInDrawOrder
description: Returns the identifier of every element of the current database, or of the given databases, in Archicad's drawing order (the order set by Bring to Front and Send to Back), as ACAPI_DrawOrder_DrawOrderGetNext walks it. Use the optional elementType and filters parameters for filtering. Objects that belong to another element (zone stamps, the parts of stairs and railings) are left out unless the IncludeSubElemObjects filter is given.

name: GetElementsOfDesignOptions
description: Retrieves the elements associated with the given design options. Available from Archicad 29.

name: GetElementsOfGroups
description: Gets the elements directly contained by each given group.

name: GetExportTolerance
description: Gets the export tolerance: the largest distance allowed between an arc and the straight segments that replace it when curves are segmented for export. Archicad only provides this value while an export is in progress, so outside an export the command returns an error saying so.

name: GetFavoriteContents
description: Returns the Favorites of a folder of the Favorites palette and of its subfolders (every Favorite when no folder is given), each with its folder path, classifications, element category values and property values, read through the Favorite manager. Available from Archicad 29.

name: GetFavoriteDefaults
description: Reads the element default stored in each given Favorite through the Favorite manager, without applying it or placing an element: the element type, the layer, the element ID, the folder, the library part and GDL parameters, the marker of every element type that has one, and the sub-elements with each of their kinds (Curtain Wall frames and panels, Stair treads and risers, Railing posts and rails, markers ...). Available from Archicad 29.

name: GetFavoriteDetails
description: Returns the classifications, property values and element category values stored in the given favorites, so they can be audited before elements are placed. Each property value comes with its evaluation status and default-value flag; the value itself is only returned when it has been evaluated.

name: GetFavoriteFolders
description: Returns the folder tree of the Favorites palette from its root folder: the name and path of every folder and the names of the Favorites in it. Available from Archicad 29.

name: GetFavoritePreviewImage
description: Returns the preview image of the given favorite.

name: GetFavoriteSettings
description: Reads the stored settings of the given favorites without applying them or placing an element: the element type, the folder, the library part and GDL parameters, the marker (library part and parameters) of Window and Door favorites, and the sub-elements. A favorite without a marker has no marker field, which is not an error. The other settings of the element (pens, layer, structure, etc.) are not returned.

name: GetFavoritesByType
description: Returns a list of the names of all favorites with the given element type

name: GetFills
description: Returns the details of the given Fill attributes.

name: GetFontsByName
description: Finds loaded fonts by name through Archicad's font search and returns their index (as Text and Label fields reference fonts in fontIndex) and name, or an error for a name no loaded font has.

name: GetGDLDate
description: Gets the date GDL scripts see: year, month, day, hour, minute and second.

name: GetGDLParametersOfElements
description: Gets all the GDL parameters (name, type, value) of the given elements.

name: GetGDLParametersOfLibraryParts
description: Gets the default GDL parameters (name, display name, type, array dimensions, value, flags) of the given library parts by name, read from the library part without placing it or changing any defaults. The output is in the format of GetGDLParametersOfElements, without isLocked and possibleValues, which need a placed element. To read a part by its file name, as SetLibraryPartParameters writes it, use GetLibraryPartParameterValues.

name: GetGDLUserGlobals
description: Returns the current GDL global variables the GDL interpreter gets, with their names, types and values. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetGeoLocation
description: Gets the project location details: the project location, and the survey point's position, geo-referencing parameters, visibility and lock state (the lock from Archicad 26).

name: GetGhostStorySettings
description: Gets the Trace & Reference ghost story settings of the floor plan: whether it is on, whether one story, the story above or the one below is shown, which story, its color and the element types shown in it.

name: GetGraphicOverrideCombinations
description: Gets all graphic override combinations of the project with the rules they contain. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetGraphicOverrideRuleGroups
description: Gets all graphic override rule groups of the project with the rules they contain, empty groups included. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetGraphicOverrideRules
description: Gets all graphic override rules of the project, with their rule group, criterion and style. With includeCriterion the criterion also comes as structured conditions, which CreateGraphicOverrideRules and ModifyGraphicOverrideRules take back. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetGraphicOverrideRulesByName
description: Gets graphic override rules by name, with their rule group, criterion and style. The rule group narrows the search; without it the rule is searched in every rule group. With includeCriterion the criterion also comes as structured conditions. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetGraphicalOverrideRules
description: Returns every graphic override rule with its criterion XML. Needs Archicad 27 or later.

name: GetGraphicalOverrideStyleOfElements
description: Returns the graphic override style each element is drawn with in the current window: for every overridable member (line type, pens, fill types, surfaces, ...) whether the active graphic override combination replaces it, and with what. Needs Archicad 27 or later.

name: GetGridElementDefaults
description: Returns the Grid Tool defaults: library part, size and GDL parameters of a new grid element. Needs Archicad 26 or later.

name: GetGridElements
description: Lists the grid elements (placed with the Grid Tool or created by CreateGridElements) with their position, angle, size, library part and optionally GDL parameters. Needs Archicad 26 or later.

name: GetGridSettings
description: Gets the grid and snap grid settings of the database of the current window, and which database that is. Each database has its own grid settings. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetGroupsOfElements
description: Gets the identifier of the group that directly contains each given element. Returns an error for elements that are not part of any group.

name: GetHierarchicalElementOwners
description: Gets the owner of each given element in its hierarchical element: the root (e.g. the Curtain Wall, Stair or Railing of a frame, tread or post) or the immediate parent. Also returns whether the given element is a main element, a subelement or not part of a hierarchical element.

name: GetHotlinkDesignOptionTableDetails
description: Reads the design option table of hotlink nodes: the design option sets, options and combinations of the hotlinked source file, and which of them the node shows. Available from Archicad 29.

name: GetHotlinkDesignOptionTables
description: Retrieves the design option table of the given hotlink nodes and placed hotlink instances: the filter mode (main model only, by options or by combination), the design option sets, options and combinations of the hotlinked module and which of them are active. Available from Archicad 29.

name: GetHotlinkOwnersOfElements
description: Tells for each element whether it comes from a hotlinked module, and returns the hotlink element that contains it and the hotlink instance it belongs to. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetHotlinkProxyElementTable
description: Maps the proxy elements of placed hotlink instances to the elements of the source file they were made from, so an element seen in a hotlinked module can be traced back to its source element.

name: GetHotlinkSourceStatus
description: Tells for each hotlink source file whether it is available, missing, not accessible, incompatible or offline. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetHotlinks
description: Gets the file system locations (path) of the hotlink modules and the instance elements placed from each node. The hotlinks can have tree hierarchy in the project.

name: GetHotspotsOfElements
description: Gets the 2D hotspots of the given library part instances (Objects, Lamps, Windows, Doors, Skylights, Zones, Curtain Wall parts, etc.), e.g. to dimension to them.

name: GetIFCAssignments
description: Returns the IFC assignments of the project: the root IFC groups, and for each object the objects assigned to it (children) and the objects it is assigned to (parents). Each object is given by its hash value, its element where it belongs to one, its IFC type and its GlobalId. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetIFCAttributesOfElements
description: Retrieves the IFC attributes (Name, Description, ObjectType, Tag, PredefinedType, LongName, ...) of the given elements, subelements included: the name, the IFC value type and the value of each attribute. On Archicad 25, 26 and 27 storedOnly returns only the attributes stored on the elements.

name: GetIFCClassificationReferencesOfElements
description: Retrieves the IFC classification references of the given elements, subelements included: identification, name, location, description and sort (from Archicad 29), the name of the IfcRelAssociatesClassification (from Archicad 28), the referenced classification (name, source, edition, edition date, description and location) and whether the reference comes from the preview translator or is stored locally. On Archicad 25, 26 and 27 the source is not given and storedOnly returns only the references stored on the elements.

name: GetIFCExportTranslators
description: Lists the IFC export translators of the project in the order of Archicad's translator list. preview marks the first one, which the Archicad API documents as the preview translator; no API identifies the preview translator otherwise, and in some projects the IFC Translators dialog shows another one as preview. Pass one of the names to IFCFileOperation as translatorName.

name: GetIFCIdsOfElements
description: Retrieves the IFC identifiers of the given elements. Before Archicad 28 it also returns their IFC GlobalIds.

name: GetIFCPropertiesOfElements
description: Retrieves the IFC properties of the given elements.

name: GetIFCSpatialStructure
description: Returns the IfcProject, IfcSite and IfcBuilding objects of the project's IFC model (hash value, IFC type and GlobalId), and for the given elements the index of the story they are assigned to in the IFC model. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetIFCTypeOfElements
description: Retrieves the IFC types of the given elements.

name: GetIssues
description: Retrieves information about existing issues.

name: GetKeynoteAutoTexts
description: Retrieves the autotext tokens of the given keynote items. The tokens can be used as label text content to reference the fields of a keynote item. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetKeynoteTree
description: Retrieves the whole keynote folder and item hierarchy. The technical root folder is not included in the output; the top-level folders and items are returned directly. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetLCSOfAnalyticalMembers
description: Retrieves the local coordinate system of the given analytical member parts, optionally in their intersection with another member part. Available from Archicad 26.

name: GetLast3DDefaultLevels
description: Gets the last 3D default levels of the given element types' defaults.

name: GetLastValidEmbeddedLibraryPartName
description: Gets the name and file path of the last valid library part of the embedded library.

name: GetLayerCombinations
description: Returns the details of layer combination attributes.

name: GetLayerOfElementDefaults
description: Returns the layer of the tool defaults of the given element types: the layer new elements of that type are placed on.

name: GetLayers
description: Returns the details of the given Layer attributes.

name: GetLayoutCustomScheme
description: Gets the Layout Info Panel custom field definitions (name and key) from Book Settings.

name: GetLayoutSettings
description: Gets settings of layouts, including their master layout and Layout Info Panel custom data fields.

name: GetLayoutSubsetSettings
description: Gets the settings of existing Layout Book subsets: the same fields CreateLayoutSubset accepts (name, ID prefix, numbering style, ...).

name: GetLibPartTransformations
description: Gets the placement transformation of library part instances (Window, Door, Object, Lamp, Zone) as Archicad computes it: the location, the rotation angle and the x/y scaling. The output is aligned with the input array of elements.

name: GetLibraries
description: Gets the list of loaded libraries. From Archicad 28 a library package also gets its package information (ID, versions, minimum Archicad version and dependencies).

name: GetLibrariesOfLibParts
description: Gets the library of each given library part (by file name or guid): display name, location, embedded/built-in/package/local/missing flags and the Library Manager tree path. Available from Archicad 29.

name: GetLibraryPart2DPrimitives
description: Gets the lines, arcs and polygons (with their holes, and whether they are fills) of the 2D symbol of a loaded library part, drawn with its default parameters or with the parameters of a placed instance.

name: GetLibraryPartCustomSection
description: Gets a custom section of a loaded library part by its section identifier and index: whether it exists, its data version and its content as base64. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetLibraryPartDetails
description: Gets the details of loaded library parts, by name or index: path, library tree path, containing library, and for GDL objects the GUID, subtype, license, UI default flag, which scripts and pictures they have, and optionally the interface and migration scripts. Can also tell whether each one is in the subtype of another library part. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetLibraryPartFileInfo
description: Reads library part files (.gsm) without loading them into the libraries of the project: the unique ID of the part, the unique ID of its subtype and its master, parameter, 2D, 3D and properties scripts. Password protected parts need their password. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetLibraryPartIdentities
description: Gets the unique ID (main and revision GUID), the reference GUID and the Teamwork lock status of library parts given by index or file path, and whether they are in a server library.

name: GetLibraryPartMetadata
description: Returns the description, keywords, author and placeable, password protected and hierarchical pages flags of loaded library parts, given by file name. Use it to search library parts by description or keywords and to tell placeable parts from macros. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetLibraryPartOriginalLocations
description: Gets the original location of the given library parts, the file they came from, e.g. before they were embedded into the project. The library parts are given by the index GetAvailableLibraryParts returns. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetLibraryPartParameterValues
description: Returns the parameters of loaded library parts, given by their file name as GetAvailableLibraryParts returns it, with their default values and descriptions, in the format of GetGDLParametersOfElements: the read counterpart of SetLibraryPartParameters. Unlike GetGDLParametersOfLibraryParts, which finds a part by its name and also returns the index, flags and value descriptions of each parameter, it reads through the Library Manager. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetLibraryPartPictures
description: Gets the preview picture and the GDL pictures of a loaded library part as base64 encoded PNGs, and from Archicad 29 also their dark user interface variants. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetLibraryPartScripts
description: Gets the master, parameter, 2D, 3D and properties scripts of loaded library parts, given by name or by an element placed from them, with the unique ID of each part. A script section the part does not have is reported as not present. Password protected parts need their password. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetLibraryPartSection
description: Reads the text of a text section (a script or the comment) of a library part given by index, without opening it in the GDL editor. Takes the password of a protected library part.

name: GetLibraryPartSections
description: Lists the sections of library parts given by index: their four-character type code, sub-identifier, size and whether they are text (scripts, comments) or binary (previews).

name: GetLibraryPartTypeDetails
description: Returns the type details of the given library parts (ACAPI_LibraryPart_GetDetails): full unique ID and its direct parent's, type, the detail flags of objects, lamps, labels and zones, the frame and orientation settings of doors and windows, and the element type and variation of the tool that places the library part. For their path, library, GUID, license and scripts see GetLibraryPartDetails.

name: GetLineFromUser
description: Waits for the user to input a line in the active Archicad window and returns start and end coordinates.

name: GetLines
description: Returns the details of the given Line attributes.

name: GetLinkedPropertyObjectsOfElements
description: Gets how property objects (the library parts of the old listing system) are linked to the given elements, or to the element defaults of the given element types: whether the property objects matching their criteria are linked, which of them match, and which one is assigned individually, each with the library part's index (the same as the index returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts), name and guid. The output is aligned with the input array of elements.

name: GetLinksOfElements
description: Gets the links created by LinkElements that start from the given elements: the linked element and the flags of each link. Links pointing to an element are not returned; query the elements they start from. Returns an error item for an element that does not exist.

name: GetLockableObjectSetStatus
description: Returns the Teamwork reservation status of a non-element lockable object set and the users who hold it.

name: GetMEPDistributionSystems
description: Retrieves the MEP distribution systems of the project with their domain, MEP system attribute, member elements, physical systems (from Archicad 29) and optionally their tree: the elements from the root element on, each with its previous and next elements and the connecting ports. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetMEPElementDetails
description: Retrieves the type-specific details of the given MEP elements: insulation thickness and routing segment of rigid segments, control points and polyline of flexible segments, radius factor, insulation thickness, preference table and routing node of elbows (from Archicad 29), angle, length and insulation thickness of branches, and offsets, wider and narrower ports, insulation thickness, routing node and (from Archicad 29) preference table of transitions. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetMEPElements
description: Retrieves the MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) elements of the project (every element the MEP API lists, and from Archicad 30 the electrical panels and devices), optionally filtered by type and domain. MEP elements are ordinary elements, so the generic element commands work on them as well (for example they can be deleted with the DeleteElements command). Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetMEPPhysicalSystemsOfElements
description: Returns the physical systems each of the given MEP elements is part of. Available from Archicad 29.

name: GetMEPPorts
description: Retrieves the ports of the given MEP elements including position, shape, size, connection status (Archicad 27: whether the port is connected, from Archicad 28: whether it is physically connected) and connection style (from Archicad 30), the flow direction of piping and ventilation ports (from Archicad 28), the nominal size of piping ports (from Archicad 30), and the outer diameter, wall thickness and flange size (Archicad 30) of piping and ventilation ports. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetMEPPreferenceTableContainers
description: Lists the preference tables of the Piping, Ventilation and Cable Carrier preference table containers of Archicad 27: their id, name, whether they exist and their number of rows per shape, and whether the container exists. Only for Archicad 27; from Archicad 28 use GetMEPPreferenceTables.

name: GetMEPPreferenceTableRows
description: Gets rows of a segment, branch, elbow or (from Archicad 29) transition preference table by their key (the reference ids and, for branch and elbow rows from Archicad 29, the angle): whether the row is valid and its values (diameters, wall thickness, radius, length, angle, branch offset, connection length, description), and whether the table exists. Rectangular duct and cable carrier segment tables only give whether they exist, as their rows have no key. On Archicad 27, which has one kind of preference table, a row is found by its shape and index and has a value and a description; the table's name and number of rows per shape are returned too. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetMEPPreferenceTables
description: Gets the circular cross section preference tables (referenceId, diameter, wall thickness, description) and the reference set of the Piping or Ventilation domain, optionally with the elbow, branch and transition preference tables, plus the rectangular duct tables of the Ventilation domain or the segment tables of the CableCarrier domain. Each table has its name and whether it is editable; the segment tables also have their segmentation lengths from Archicad 29. The rows of the circular, elbow, branch and transition tables say whether they are valid, and the reference set and the angle set say which of their reference ids and angles are defined. The angle set and the transition tables are available from Archicad 29. Every row has its index in the table, as ModifyMEPPreferenceTables expects it. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetMEPRoutingElements
description: Retrieves the details of the given MEP routing elements: domain, MEP system, offset from the home story, branch preference table, the ports logically connected at the route's beginning and end, the floor plan display settings (cut plane position, floor plan display option, show projection and on-story visibility, from Archicad 29), route polyline, segments with cross section data (shape, size, preference table and reference id), begin and end nodes, anchor, reference line offsets, wall thickness, flange size, connection style, insulation thickness and rigid segments, and nodes with their incoming and outgoing segments, preferred transition placement, elbows and transitions. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetMEPRoutingParameters
description: Gets the routing parameters of placed MEP elements: of a routing element its routing node parameters (preferred transition placement, elbow from Archicad 29, transition) and routing segment parameters (cross section, preference table, anchor, reference line offsets, wall thickness, flange size, connection style); of a routing node its elbow (from Archicad 29) and transition parameters; of a routing segment its rigid segment parameters (Archicad 28 only). Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetMEPSystemGroups
description: Gets the MEP system groups of the project with their physical systems: name, editable flag, root element and MEP system. Available from Archicad 29.

name: GetMEPSystems
description: Returns the details of the given MEP System attributes (domain, pens, fill, center line type, surface and insulation surface).

name: GetMEPToolDefaults
description: Retrieves the current settings of the MEP tools per domain, without changing them: the routing tool (MEP system, branch preference table, floor plan display settings from Archicad 29, and its segment, node, elbow (Archicad 27 and from Archicad 29) and transition defaults), its rigid segment and branch defaults, the flexible segment tool, the library part, insulation and port settings of the terminal, accessory, fitting and equipment tools, and from Archicad 30 the electrical panel tool with its number of circuit defaults. Archicad 27 gives fewer settings, and only the shape of the ports. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetMagicWandSettings
description: Returns the settings of Archicad's Magic Wand Settings dialog: how curves are approximated with straight segments (a number of segments along arcs or circles, a largest deviation from the curve, or a segment length) and the trace method. Useful to know how the Magic Wand will trace a curve. Changes nothing in the project.

name: GetMainGroups
description: Gets the top level group of each given group. A group that is not nested in another group is its own top level group.

name: GetMarkerParametersOfElements
description: Gets the marker library part and the marker's GDL parameters (name, type, value) of the given Window and Door elements. The marker is the stamp drawn next to the opening on the floor plan; its parameters are separate from the opening's own GDL parameters, which GetGDLParametersOfElements returns.

name: GetMarquee
description: Gets the marquee of the current window: its shape (rectangle, rotated rectangle or polygon), whether it is multi-story, and its outline as a polygon. Returns the type 'none' when there is no marquee.

name: GetMergedElements
description: Gets the elements each queried element is merged with, one item per queried element; an unknown element is an error item.

name: GetMissingAttributes
description: Lists the references of placed elements to layers, fills, surfaces, building materials, composites, profiles, line types, pen tables and zone categories that do not exist in the project, for the given types or all of them, and of the tool defaults, Favorites, graphic override rules, Model View Options combinations and attributes: the structured counterpart of the missing attributes report of Archicad's GDL palette. Every element of the floor plan and of every view and layout (hotlinked ones too) is checked, and so is every tool default and Favorite (with its sub-elements): its layer, its attribute fields and memo data as ReindexAttributes finds them, its composite or profile when its structure type uses one, a drawing's own pen table, and its library part parameters of attribute types; of every graphic override rule the line type, fill and surface it overrides with; of every Model View Options combination the surfaces and line types of the stair and railing schemes and the library part settings' GDL parameters of attribute types; of every composite the building materials of its skins and the line types of its separators, of every building material its cut fill and cut surface, of every surface the fill of its vectorial hatching, of every MEP system its fill, center line type and surfaces, and of every profile the building material, surface or fill of each skin and its contour, cut end and edge line types. The sources input limits the check to elements, tool defaults, Favorites, graphic override rules, Model View Options or attributes. Each item names the source; for an element the element (and the element it is part of, for a curtain wall frame, a column segment, ...) and the story or view it sits on, for a tool default the tool, for a Favorite its name and tool, for a graphic override rule its guid and name, for a Model View Options combination its guid and name (and the library part option set), for an attribute its type, guid and name; then the attribute type, the missing index and the field or GDL parameter that holds it. Index 0 counts as no attribute. Read only. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetMissingLibPartNames
description: Gets the library part name of the given placed Object, Lamp, Window or Door elements, even if the library containing the part is not loaded. Use it to find the parts of elements that are shown as dots because their library part is missing.

name: GetModelExtent
description: Returns the 3D extent (xMin, yMin, zMin, xMax, yMax, zMax) of the current database, the region Archicad's Fit in Window would show.

name: GetModelViewOptionDetails
description: Gets the settings stored in model view option combinations (Document > Model View > Model View Options), all of them or the ones given by id or by name: the model view options in the fields of GetViewOptions, and the options library parts add to the combination (gdlOptions) with their GDL parameter values. Read-only: the Archicad API has no function to change, rename or create a stored combination; SetViewOptions changes the options of the current window. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetModelViewOptions
description: Gets all model view options

name: GetModulData
description: Gets the module data Tapir stored in the project with StoreModulData: the given names, or all of them, with their data version and, unless includeContent is false, their content. Module data are the custom data sections of Archicad's ModulData Manager: text saved in the project file under a name, kept apart from project data (SetProjectData).

name: GetNavigatorItemTree
description: Returns the full navigator item tree for the specified map. With includeChildCount true every item also reports the number of its direct children.

name: GetNavigatorParentItems
description: Returns the parent of each given navigator item: the folder, subset or layout book item it is in. The root of a map has no parent and gets an error.

name: GetNoteAutoTextKeywords
description: Retrieves the keywords of note autotexts (the autotexts of dimension, label and other element notes) by their numeric API_NoteAutotextID values. Available from Archicad 26.

name: GetNoteAutotexts
description: Retrieves the autotexts available in the notes of an element type (e.g. a Dimension), each with the element types it is available for. The autotexts are identified by the numeric value of their API_NoteAutotextID. For a Dimension, the optional dimensionAppearance (Linear by default) chooses the dimension type. Needs Archicad 26 or later.

name: GetOpeningDefault
description: Returns the settings of the Opening tool defaults: the extrusion parameters (as GetOpeningDetails returns them) and the floor plan parameters (as GetOpeningFloorPlanParameters returns them). Available from Archicad 29.

name: GetOpeningDetails
description: Returns the details of Opening elements: whether they exist, the parent element, the cut and connected elements, the geometry (anchor point, extrusion direction, axes, polygon) and the extrusion parameters (constraint, limit type, linked status, shape type, size, anchor, offsets, surface overrides). Available from Archicad 29.

name: GetOpeningFloorPlanParameters
description: Returns the floor plan parameters of Opening elements: the floor plan display mode, the divided opening mode, the open edge style, the reference axis, the cut surface and outline lines, the cover fills and the cut and uncut symbols. Available from Archicad 29.

name: GetOpeningSymbolParameters
description: Returns the GDL parameters of the cut and uncut floor plan symbols of Opening elements, in the format of GetGDLParametersOfElements. A symbol the opening does not have is left out. Available from Archicad 29.

name: GetOpeningTransformations
description: Gets the placement of Opening elements, Windows, Doors and Skylights without changing them: a global-to-local transformation matrix, its inverse, and the origin and axes in world coordinates derived from the inverse. For Windows, Doors and Skylights the local-to-global matrix is the one Archicad returns, and mirrored ones give a left-handed matrix (isMirrored). For Opening elements it is built from the opening geometry (Archicad 29 and later): origin at the anchor point, the X and Y axes of the opening and Z = X × Y, which points against the extrusion direction. Needs Archicad 27 or later.

name: GetPenTables
description: Returns the details of the given Pen Table attributes.

name: GetPens
description: Returns the given pens, or all of them, in effect in the current window: index, color, width and description. It also works when the pens in effect are not a Pen Table attribute. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetPointFromUser
description: Asks the designer to click a point in the current window and returns it. Archicad waits for the click or for Escape, and every other JSON command queues behind this one until then; the call fails when the input is cancelled.

name: GetPolygonFromUser
description: Waits for the user to input a polygon in the active Archicad window and returns its points and arcs.

name: GetPrinterAndPlotterInfo
description: Retrieves the printer selected in Archicad, with its name and orientation, and the selected plotter, with its name and model.

name: GetPrinterInfo
description: Retrieves Archicad's current print settings: the print area, grid, fixed text size and scale (the settings PrintView takes).

name: GetProductVersionInfo
description: Retrieves the version information of the running Archicad: build number, language code, product family and version text, plus the product name, product type, main/update/hotfix versions, the available domains (Architecture, MEP) and the CEIP project identifier of the open project from Archicad 29. Requires Archicad 28 or later.

name: GetProfiles
description: Returns the details of the given Profile attributes.

name: GetProjectData
description: Gets the content of the project data with the given names.

name: GetProjectDataKeys
description: Lists the project data stored by Tapir in the project: the names, the identifiers of the add-on objects that store them, whether they are kept on this client only and the Teamwork user who has reserved them. Project data is text (for example JSON) saved in the project file by scripts and Grasshopper definitions, such as their settings or the mapping of elements to an external system.

name: GetProjectInfo
description: Retrieves information about the currently loaded project.

name: GetProjectInfoFields
description: Retrieves the names and values of all project info fields.

name: GetProjectInfoGroups
description: Retrieves the Project Info groups in their order, each with its fields: id, name, value and, when exactly one project info autotext has the name of the field, the autotext key that SetProjectInfoField takes. Available from Archicad 30.

name: GetProjectNotes
description: Gets the Project Notes of the project (File > Info > Project Notes): client, project name, company, address, architect, draftsmen, project status, date of issue, keywords and notes.

name: GetProjectPreferences
description: Gets pages of the project preferences (Options > Project Preferences): the working units, the dimensions, the calculation units, the zones and the reference levels, and the Floor Plan Cut Plane Settings. Further pages may follow.

name: GetPropertiesOfToolDefaults
description: Returns the property definitions of the tool defaults (the settings new elements get) of the given element types, filtered by kind (all by default), and optionally the value of each property in the tool default.

name: GetPropertyAvailabilityOfDefaults
description: Tells whether the given properties are available and whether they are visible in the current tool default of an element type, before creating new elements. It checks the native tool default only, not a Favorite that is not applied. Unknown properties are reported as errors, not as unavailable. Available from Archicad 26.

name: GetPropertyDefinitionsOfAttributes
description: Returns the property definitions of the given attributes (for example Building Materials): the user defined, the fundamental built-in, or all of them.

name: GetPropertyDefinitionsOfElementComponents
description: Returns the property definitions available on the given element components, optionally filtered to user defined or built-in ones.

name: GetPropertyEditability
description: Tells whether the values of the given properties can be modified, and whether the properties are visible, for the given elements. Also tells whether they can be modified in the tool defaults of element types (from Archicad 26) and in the default values of the property definitions themselves. Unknown elements, element types and properties are reported as errors, not as locked properties.

name: GetPropertyExpressionReferences
description: Returns the strings that refer to the given properties in property expressions.

name: GetPropertyObjectsOfElements
description: Gets the property objects of the given elements: the library parts of the old listing system (used by projects migrated from older Archicad versions) linked to each element by criteria or individually, with the library part's index (the same as the index returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts), name and guid. The output is aligned with the input array of elements.

name: GetPropertyValuesOfAttributes
description: Returns the property values of the attributes for the given property. With includeStatus it also returns whether each property is available, editable and visible for the attribute (from 1.7.3).

name: GetPropertyValuesOfElementComponents
description: Returns the property values of the given element components for the given properties, in the shape of GetPropertyValuesOfElements. Use GetComponentsOfElements to list the components of an element.

name: GetPropertyValuesOfElementDefaults
description: Returns the values of the given properties in the current tool default of an element type, which new elements of that type get. It reads the native tool default of the generic variation of the type, not a Favorite that is not applied. A property that is not available for the tool default is reported as an error.

name: GetPropertyValuesOfElements
description: Returns the property values of the elements for the given property. It works for subelements of hierarchal elements also. With includeAvailability it also tells whether each property is available for the element.

name: GetPublisherSets
description: Returns the publisher sets of the project with their saved output: the local or LAN path, the Teamwork file server path, or the Internet host and directory name.

name: GetQuantitiesOfElements
description: Gets the quantities of the given elements calculated by Archicad (volumes, surfaces, lengths etc.), together with the volume and projected area per building material (one item per skin of composite and complex profile elements, one item for basic elements). Supported types: Wall, Column, Beam, Slab, Roof, Shell, Morph, Zone, ColumnSegment, BeamSegment. Use the optional minOpeningSize parameter to control the conditional values, and calculateInOneCall to calculate all the elements in one Archicad call.

name: GetRelationsOfElements
description: Gets the type-specific relations of the given elements: endpoint and reference line connections of walls, beams and beam segments, boundary elements and boundary sections of zones, the zones on the two sides of windows, doors, skylights and curtain wall panels, and the zones connected to roofs and shells. Available from Archicad 26.

name: GetRenderingScenes
description: Gets the names of the rendering scenes of the project (the Scene list of the PhotoRendering Settings palette), the most recently used first, and the name of the current scene.

name: GetRenovationFilters
description: Gets the renovation filters of the project, and the one the current window uses (Document > Renovation > Renovation Filter). A renovationFilterId has the same shape as the renovationFilterGuid of GetViewSettings and SetViewSettings, so a filter listed here can be set on saved views too.

name: GetRenovationStatusNames
description: Gets the names the running Archicad shows for the renovation statuses Existing, New and Demolished (localized). Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetReservationStatusOfElements
description: Returns the Teamwork reservation status of elements without reserving them: whether each element is free, reserved by the current user or reserved by another user, with the reserving user. New elements stay reserved by the user who created them until they are released.

name: GetRevisionChangeCustomScheme
description: Retrieves the custom fields of changes (the change custom scheme): the key and the name of each field. The keys are the customSchemeKey values in the customSchemeData of changes.

name: GetRevisionChanges
description: Retrieves all changes.

name: GetRevisionChangesOfElements
description: Retrieves the changes belong to the given elements.

name: GetRevisionIssues
description: Retrieves all issues.

name: GetRoofPlanes
description: Gets the single planes of roofs, without changing the roofs. A multi-plane roof is decomposed by Archicad into its planes, each returned with its part identifier and its details as a single-plane roof (slope, pivot line, level, outline with arcs and holes); a single-plane roof is returned as its only plane. The output is aligned with the input array of elements.

name: GetRoomImage
description: Returns the room image of the given zone.

name: GetSchedules
description: Returns the Interactive Schedules of the Project Map: navigator item id, name, ID and the folders they are in. Archicad's API does not give the rows of a schedule nor export it; to export one, put it in a publisher set with a spreadsheet format in Archicad and run PublishPublisherSet.

name: GetScriptUIResult
description: Retrieves and clears the result last submitted from a Script UI window's page (via window.ACAPI.SubmitResult), if any, and reports whether the window is still open, so a waiting script can stop when the user closes it. The window is picked by uiId or scriptId; without them the first window is used.

name: GetSectionElements
description: Gets the elements drawn in the given section, elevation or interior elevation databases, each with the owner element it was generated from. This is the only command that returns raw section element identifiers - every other listing command converts them to their owner - so it is the way to obtain the sectionElementId that CreateAssociativeDimensionsOnSection requires.

name: GetSectionsAndElevationsDetails
description: Gets every configurable setting of the given Section and Elevation elements, with their name and reference ID.

name: GetSelectedElements
description: Gets the list of the currently selected elements.

name: GetShapePrimitivesOfElements
description: Returns the 2D drawing primitives of each given floor plan element in the same format as GetDrawingPrimitivesOfElements, but drawn as ACAPI_DrawingPrimitive_ShapePrims draws it by default (on the current story, clipped as Archicad clips it) instead of on every story and unclipped. With includeMarkers the objects attached to the elements (window and door markers, drawing titles, ...) are drawn with them or left out; Archicad's setting is changed back afterwards. An element on another story gets an error item. The floor plan must be the current database. The output is aligned with the input array of elements.

name: GetSkylightHolePolygons
description: Gets the polygon of the hole each given Skylight cuts into its host Roof or Shell: the outline and any holes of it as 2D coordinates. The output is aligned with the input array of elements; an element that is not a Skylight gets an error item.

name: GetSnapPointsOfElements
description: Gets the snap points (hotspots) of the given elements, of any element type: the points of an element that the cursor snaps to and dimensions attach to (for example the endpoints of a Wall's reference line or the vertices of a Slab), in world coordinates, each with the neig kind and subindex identifying which point of the element it is. For the 2D hotspots of library part instances see GetHotspotsOfElements. The output is aligned with the input array of elements.

name: GetSolidElementLinks
description: Returns solid element operation links for each queried element, grouped by role (target or operator).

name: GetSpecialFolders
description: Retrieves the filesystem paths of the special folders of the running Archicad (preferences, cache, data, temporary, application, defaults, templates, help, embedded project library, etc.).

name: GetSplineMaxDistances
description: Measures how far the given 2D coordinates are from a segment of a Spline element, between two of its fit points, with its own Bezier handles: returns the largest distance, for example to check how well a polyline follows the spline. The output is aligned with the input array. Changes nothing in the project.

name: GetStories
description: Retrieves information about the story structure of the currently loaded project: index, floor id, name, level, height and, from Archicad 28, the IFC GlobalId of each story.

name: GetStoryControlPrimitives
description: Returns the 2D drawing primitives of the story levels (story lines and their markers) drawn in the given section, elevation or interior elevation database, as ACAPI_DrawingPrimitive_DrawStoryControl draws them, in the same format as GetDrawingPrimitivesOfElements. The databaseId can be obtained with GetDatabaseIdFromNavigatorItemId.

name: GetStructureDisplay
description: Gets the Partial Structure Display (EntireStructure, CoreOnly, WithoutFinishes or StructureOnly) of the current window, and whether it is the 3D window. This is the setting of the window itself, not the one stored in a saved view (see GetViewSettings). Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetSubelementsOfHierarchicalElements
description: Gets the subelements of the given hierarchical elements. From Archicad 28 the subelements of external hierarchical elements (for example MEP elements or elements of other add-ons) are returned as externalSubelements.

name: GetSunSettings
description: Gets the project's date and time (Options > Project Preferences > Location Settings), the sun position Archicad calculates for them at the project location, and the sun and ambient light settings.

name: GetSurfaceQuantitiesOfElements
description: Gets the exposed surface areas of the given elements calculated by Archicad: for each element one item per surface attribute and building material pair with the area that is not covered by the covering elements (for example the wall area behind a slab is taken off the wall's surface). The covering elements are the optional coverElements; by default every construction element of the project. The output is aligned with the input array of elements.

name: GetSurfaceTypesOfElements
description: Gets the surface type of every polygon of the 3D model of the given elements, as ACAPI_Polygon_PolygonId2SurfaceType returns it: for each element its polygons with their body index, polygon index, polygon id and the numeric API_SurfaceTypeID value. The model is generated with separate components in a temporary sight, so the 3D window is not changed. The output is aligned with the input array of elements. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetSurfaces
description: Returns the details of the given Surface attributes.

name: GetSurveyPointTransformation
description: Gets the 3x4 matrix that transforms points from the Project Origin coordinate system into the Survey Point coordinate system, row by row, and its inverse when it is invertible. Read only. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetSuspendGroupsMode
description: Gets the current state of the Suspend Groups mode.

name: GetTeamworkAccessRights
description: Returns whether the role of the current user has the given Teamwork access rights (API_TWAccessRights names without the API prefix, e.g. LayersCreate), all of them when no names are given.

name: GetTeamworkOwnersOfDatabases
description: Returns the Teamwork owner (user id and name) of each given database, e.g. of a layout or a view database. The user id is 0 when nobody owns the database.

name: GetTeamworkProjectInfo
description: Tells whether the opened project is a Teamwork project and whether it is online, and returns its BIMcloud server, project name and the current user (id and name).

name: GetTeamworkRightsOfObjects
description: Returns for each given object, for example an element, whether the current Teamwork user has the right to create objects of its kind and to delete or modify it.

name: GetTeamworkStatus
description: Returns whether the opened project is a Teamwork project and is online, the members of the shared project and who has reserved the Hotlink and XRef management. Works in a solo project too, then isShared and isOnline are false.

name: GetTextureCoordinates
description: Gets the texture coordinates (u, v) of the faces of the 3D model of the given elements: per solid body, per face, at the first vertex of the face. The output is aligned with the input array of elements.

name: GetToolboxItems
description: Lists the tools of the Toolbox, the tools of add-ons included, in the form SetCurrentTool accepts, and the active tool. includeHidden also lists the tools without an icon, e.g. the Slab Accessory.

name: GetURLReferencesOfElements
description: Gets the web link (URL reference) of the given elements: a URL with a description, shown in Archicad in the element's settings under Element Information > Link. An element without a link gets the error APIERR_NOUSERDATA.

name: GetUnusedAttributes
description: Lists the unused layers, fills, surfaces, building materials, composites, profiles, line types, pen tables and zone categories (index, id and name), for the given types or all of them. The Archicad API has no function that tells which attributes are unused (only how many per type), so every reference is collected: the elements of the floor plan and of every view and layout (hotlinked ones too), with their library part parameters and memo data, the tool defaults, the Favorites, the other attributes (composites, building materials, surfaces, profiles, MEP systems) and the graphic override rules, the way ReindexAttributes finds them; for layers the layer of each element, tool default and Favorite; for composites and profiles the walls, slabs, roofs, shells, column and beam segments whose structure type uses them; for pen tables the current pen table and the drawings set to a pen table of their own. An attribute that only an unused attribute refers to counts as used. Indices typed into GDL scripts and the pen tables saved with views are not found. Each type also reports Archicad's own count of the attributes in use (archicadUsedCount, see GetUsedAttributes), so a difference shows. Read only. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetUnusedLibraryParts
description: Lists the loaded library parts that no element of the project is placed from. Read only. The Archicad API does not tell which library parts are used, so every element of the floor plan and of every view and layout is checked: objects, lamps, doors, windows, skylights, zone stamps, symbol labels, drawing titles, curtain wall parts, and the markers of doors, windows, skylights, sections, elevations, details and worksheets. A library part used only in another way (called as a macro, linked as a property object, as an interior elevation marker, in stairs and railings, in the tool defaults or in Favorites) is listed as unused. Library parts that cannot be placed (e.g. macros) are only listed with includeNotPlaceable.

name: GetUsedAttributes
description: Gets how many attributes of each type are in use (layers, lines, fills, composites, surfaces, ...), as Archicad reports them for the usedAttributes JSON query: the counts in usedAttributes, the report as text in raw. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GetUserDataOfAttributes
description: Reads the key-value pairs stored on attributes by SetUserDataOfAttributes. An attribute without user data returns no pairs; one holding user data in another layout returns an error.

name: GetUserDataOfGroups
description: Gets the user data an add-on attached to each given group: its version, platform sign, flags and bytes (base64 encoded), and, when its version is 1 (the layout SetUserDataOfGroups writes), its key-value pairs. Returns an error for groups that have no user data.

name: GetUserGSID
description: Get the current registered User-GSID and OrganizationsID. Requires Archicad 27 or later.

name: GetView2DTransformations
description: Get zoom and rotation of 2D views

name: GetViewOptions
description: Gets the model view options and on-screen view options of the current plan window, and the index and name of the model view option combination it applies.

name: GetViewSettings
description: Gets the view settings of navigator items

name: GetVisibleSkinStatus
description: Checks whether elements have a visible skin in a given Partial Structure Display mode (EntireStructure, CoreOnly, WithoutFinishes or StructureOnly), e.g. a finish-only slab has none in CoreOnly. The current window is not changed. The output is aligned with the input array of elements.

name: GetZoneBoundaries
description: Gets the boundaries of the given Zones (connected elements, neighbour zones, etc.). Accepts either a single zoneElementId or a list of zones. Prefer the list: the expensive boundary recalculation runs once per call, so querying many Zones in one call is much faster than calling the command once per Zone.

name: GetZoneCategories
description: Returns the details of the given Zone Category attributes.

name: GetZoneLabelingSettings
description: Returns whether the automatic labeling of Zones is on and the name of the Label Favorite it places. Available from Archicad 28.

name: GetZoneReductions
description: Gets the area reductions of the given Zones, as the Zone Stamp's area calculation uses them: the polygons of the Zone covered by Walls, Columns, reducing Fills, sloping Roofs and low ceilings, each with its type, the percentage it is reduced by, its area and its outline with holes. Area calculations by local standards need these parts, which GetQuantitiesOfElements only gives as totals. The output is aligned with the input array of elements.

name: GrantElements
description: Hands over the reservation of elements to another Teamwork user, given by user id, without a dialog. Available from Archicad 27.

name: GrantProjectData
description: Grants the project data with the given names, reserved by the current user, to another Teamwork user.

name: HighlightElements
description: Highlights the elements given in the elements array. In case of empty elements array removes all previously set highlights. On Archicad 25 nonHighlightedColor is ignored.

name: IFCFileOperation
description: Executes an IFC file operation: opens or merges an IFC file, or saves the project as an IFC file. A save can name the export translator to use, a merge the story the IFC file's first storey is placed on. With overwrite false a save refuses to replace an existing file.

name: ImportAttributesFromProject
description: Imports Line, Fill, ZoneCategory, PenTable, OperationProfile, Composite, Profile and LayerCombination attributes from another project or template file into the open project, with their complete definition (symbol and percent fills included), like Append or Overwrite by name in Archicad's Attribute Manager. The lines and fills a composite or profile uses are matched by name; its building materials and surfaces, and the layers of a layer combination, keep their index only with referencesByIndex, since Archicad does not read these types from a closed file. An attribute with a reference that cannot be mapped is not imported. A new attribute gets a new guid: Archicad does not hand out the guids stored in the source file. An attribute whose name already exists is skipped, or overwritten in place with overwriteExisting. dryRun reports what would happen without changing anything. The names are the legacy 8-bit names of the source file. Available from Archicad 27.

name: ImportClassificationsXml
description: Imports a Classification Manager XML export, with the given policies for systems and items that already exist. Returns the systems and items it created and removed.

name: ImportFavorites
description: Import Favorites from a .prefs file or folder into the current project. From Archicad 29 they can also be imported from a folder of Favorite files (xml format, all of them or the given fileNames) or from a legacy .prf file (legacyPRF format), with the conflict policies Error, Skip, OverwriteExisting and RenameNew. In a Teamwork project the Favorites lockable object set must be reserved first (see ReserveLockableObjectSet).

name: ImportIssuesFromBCF
description: Imports issues from the specified BCF file.

name: ImportMarkupsFromPDF
description: Imports the markups of the specified PDF file as issues, like Issue Manager > Import PDF markups, without any dialog and without opening the Issue Manager palette, and reports the issues it created. Available from Archicad 29.

name: ImportPropertiesXml
description: Imports a Property Manager XML export, with the given policy for names that already exist. Returns the property definitions it created and removed.

name: InterpretAutoTexts
description: Resolves one or more autotexts (e.g. '<LAYOUTID>') to their values, optionally in the context of an element, so a key can be tested before it is written into a Text or Label.

name: InterpretGDLScript3D
description: Runs a GDL 3D script, given as text or as the master and 3D scripts of a loaded library part with its default parameters, with the settings of the GDL editor, and returns whether it ran without a GDL error, how many 3D model elements it generated and their bounding box. The API returns no GDL error message or line number.

name: IsLibraryPartSubtypeOf
description: Checks for each of the given library parts whether the given ancestor is anywhere up its subtype hierarchy (e.g. whether a part is a kind of furniture), independent of its name. A library part is not a subtype of itself. With matchAncestorByMainId any revision of the ancestor matches.

name: IsUsableGDLString
description: Checks whether each of the given strings is usable in GDL, e.g. before writing it into a GDL parameter or script. Returns one boolean for each string.

name: LinkElements
description: Creates persistent links between pairs of elements, each from one element to another, with an optional integer flags value per link. Scripts can record their own relations between elements this way (for example which label documents which column) instead of storing GUIDs in properties. The links are stored in the project and have no effect on geometry; they are independent from groups, hotlinks and solid element operations. A link is directional: it is returned by GetLinksOfElements for the element it starts from only, and removed by UnlinkElements. Undoable.

name: LockElements
description: Locks the given elements. Manual lock, not teamwork!

name: MakePropertyAvailableForElements
description: Makes a property definition available for all the given elements. Available in Archicad 25, 26 and 27.

name: MakePropertyUnavailableForElements
description: Makes a property definition unavailable for all the given elements. Available in Archicad 25, 26 and 27.

name: MeasureTexts
description: Measures texts before placing them: the length of every line for a given font, style and height, on paper in millimetres or in the model at the current drawing scale, and the font's capital size factor. Creates nothing.

name: MergeElements
description: Merges the given construction elements (the Merge command of Archicad, which cleans up the junctions of slabs, beams, walls and similar elements). Undoable. The element types are not filtered: Archicad reports the ones it cannot merge. The merge is read back: when Archicad records no merge between the given elements (it decides which elements and type combinations it merges), the result is a failure, not a success.

name: MirrorElements
description: Mirrors elements across an axis given by two points on the floor plan, optionally as a copy. An element that cannot be edited (its layer is hidden or locked, it is locked, or it is not available in teamwork) gets a failed execution result naming the reason instead of being skipped silently.

name: ModelToScreen
description: Converts model coordinates to pixel positions local to the current Archicad view window (not global desktop coordinates), using the current window's size, drawing scale and zoom. In a 3D window the coordinates are projected with the current camera; in other windows z is disregarded. Available from Archicad 29.

name: ModifyAssociativeDimensions
description: Changes the settings of existing linear dimensions (the Dimension tool's elements, also in sections): the dimension type, the elevation origin, the line pen, the marker type and pen, the text height, pen and frame and the witness line form and value, with the same keys as the dimension creation commands. The text and witness line settings are applied to every witness point. Not written: the witness points, the dimension line position and direction (use MoveElements), the marker size, the text content and position, the witness extension line, the layout and the hole and composite wall dimensioning settings.

name: ModifyBeams
description: Modifies Beam elements based on the given parameters. CreateBeams takes the same cut fill pens and cover fill, and the same absolute zCoordinate of the reference line (with an optional floorIndex). Not written: the surfaces of the beam segments, and the cut fill pens before Archicad 27.

name: ModifyColumns
description: Modifies Column elements based on the given parameters. CreateColumns takes the same cut fill pens and cover fill. Not written: the surfaces of the column segments, and the cut fill pens before Archicad 27.

name: ModifyCurtainWallFrames
description: EXPERIMENTAL. Modifies single Curtain Wall Frames by their GUID: the frame contour (a1, a2, b1, b2), the frame class and the frame type. ACAPI_Element_Change does not take a frame on its own, so the change is written through the memo of the owner curtain wall, and read back to check that Archicad applied it.

name: ModifyCurtainWalls
description: Modifies Curtain Wall elements in place, keeping their GUID, properties and classifications: the height, the bottom elevation and story, the reference line (with the same number of segments), and the column (primary) and row (secondary) pattern with its cell assignments, in the fields of CreateCurtainWalls.

name: ModifyDetailMarkers
description: Changes the name, the reference ID, the clip polygon, the boundary's pen and line type, the marker symbol's angle, always-horizontal setting and pen of Detail and Worksheet markers. Not written: the base point (Archicad places it at the center of the clip polygon's bounding box when the marker is created), the viewpoint the marker refers to, and the marker symbol's other settings, which are parameters of the library part placed as the marker (markerId in GetDetailsOfElements). A value Archicad did not apply gets a failed execution result.

name: ModifyDoors
description: Modifies Door elements based on the given parameters.

name: ModifyElectricalCircuits
description: Modifies the description, voltage, wiring type and used phases of electrical circuits. Available from Archicad 30.

name: ModifyElectricalDevices
description: Modifies the apparent power, load classification and placement (anchor point, orientation, rotation, mirroring, library part, size) of electrical devices. Available from Archicad 30.

name: ModifyElectricalPanels
description: Modifies the name, circuit naming and placement (anchor point, orientation, rotation, mirroring, library part, size) of electrical panels. Available from Archicad 30.

name: ModifyElectricalProjectSettings
description: Modifies the electrical project settings: sets the default voltage and clears, adds or removes wiring types and load classifications. Available from Archicad 30.

name: ModifyGraphicOverrideCombinations
description: Modifies the name and/or the rules of graphic override combinations. Omitted fields are kept. Available from Archicad 27.

name: ModifyGraphicOverrideRules
description: Modifies the name, criterion or style of graphic override rules. The criterion is given as Archicad's criterion XML or as structured conditions. A given style replaces the whole style of the rule. Available from Archicad 27.

name: ModifyKeynoteFolders
description: Modifies the key, title or reference of the given keynote folders. Available from Archicad 28.

name: ModifyKeynoteItems
description: Modifies the key, title, description or reference of the given keynote items. Available from Archicad 28.

name: ModifyLabels
description: Modifies Label elements based on the given parameters.

name: ModifyLamps
description: Modifies Lamp elements based on the given parameters.

name: ModifyLevelDimensions
description: Changes existing Level Dimension elements: the position of the marker and the settings CreateLevelDimensions takes (pen, text height and pen, marker type and size, plus sign, angle, origin), with the same keys. Not written: the parent element and the static level (delete and recreate the dimension to change them), the text content and the hide-with-base-element setting.

name: ModifyLibraryList
description: Adds libraries by path and removes loaded libraries by name or path, in one change of the library list. Returns the result of each addition and removal. Available from Archicad 28.

name: ModifyMEPElements
description: Modifies placed MEP elements: the anchor point, orientation and library part of terminals, accessories, equipment, fittings and flexible segments, the control points, polyline (Piping, from Archicad 28), and width and height of flexible segments. Only the given fields are changed, in one undo step with one execution result per element; an item with a field that does not fit its element changes nothing. Archicad reports a 'libraryPartId' it does not find only after the item's other changes were made, so that item's error says which changes stayed. Available from Archicad 27.

name: ModifyMEPPhysicalSystems
description: Modifies MEP physical systems: name, root element and the MEP system used as their category. Only the given fields are changed. Available from Archicad 29.

name: ModifyMEPPorts
description: Modifies the given MEP ports (as returned by GetMEPPorts): shape, connection style (from Archicad 30), the flow direction of piping and ventilation ports, and the outer diameter and nominal size (from Archicad 30) of piping ports. Only the given fields are changed. Available from Archicad 28.

name: ModifyMEPPreferenceTables
description: Modifies the MEP preference tables of a domain, in the shape GetMEPPreferenceTables returns them: adds tables, changes their names, segmentation lengths (from Archicad 29) and row values and descriptions, deletes or empties rows, adds rows to the rectangular duct and cable carrier tables, deletes tables, deletes reference ids from the reference set, and adds and deletes angles of the angle set (from Archicad 29). Each table is changed in one undoable step. Available from Archicad 28.

name: ModifyMEPRoutingElements
description: Modifies the given MEP routing elements: MEP system, branch preference table, floor plan display settings (cut plane position, floor plan display option, show projection and on-story visibility, from Archicad 29), cross section data (shape, size, preference table and reference id), anchor, reference line offsets, wall thickness, flange size and connection style of all segments, preferred transition placement of all nodes, insulation thickness of the whole route (segments, elbows and transitions), and node positions. Available from Archicad 28.

name: ModifyMEPSystemGroups
description: Renames MEP system groups. Available from Archicad 29.

name: ModifyMeshes
description: Modifies the attributes of Mesh elements based on the given parameters.

name: ModifyMorphs
description: Modifies Morph elements based on the given parameters.

name: ModifyObjects
description: Modifies Object elements based on the given parameters.

name: ModifyOpenings
description: Modifies Opening elements: the width, the height and the base point CreateOpenings takes. Needs Archicad 28 or earlier; in Archicad 29 and later every item fails with a message pointing to SetOpeningDetails, which changes the size and the position of an opening there.

name: ModifyPens
description: Changes the color, width and description of single pens of the Pen Table in effect for the model views (the default) or the layouts, keeping every other pen as it is. Only the given fields of a listed pen are changed. In a Teamwork project the PenTables lockable object set must be reserved first (see ReserveLockableObjectSet).

name: ModifyPropertyValueOfElements
description: Sets one property value on all the given elements in a single step. If the property is not available for any of the elements, none of them is changed.

name: ModifyRailings
description: Modifies Railing elements in place: the height of their segments, the bottom offset and the home story. The reference line, the nodes and segments, and the posts, rails and panels stay as they are. Each railing is read back after the change, and a value Archicad did not apply gets a failed execution result.

name: ModifyRevisionIssues
description: Modifies the ID, the short description and the custom scheme data of the given revision issues. Only the given fields are changed. Issued revision issues may refuse the change.

name: ModifyRoofs
description: Modifies single-plane and multi-plane Roof elements based on the given parameters. The plan outline, level, thickness and structure apply to both; angle, pivotLine and edgeTrims (the cut of each polygon edge) only to single-plane roofs; levels, eavesOverhang and pivotEdges only to multi-plane roofs.

name: ModifySections
description: Changes the name and the reference ID of Section and Elevation elements, which the Project Map and the markers show. GetDetailsOfElements reads those of a Section back as name and idStr.

name: ModifyShells
description: Modifies the structure (Basic or Composite, building material or composite) of Shell elements based on the given parameters.

name: ModifySkylights
description: Modifies Skylight elements: anchor position and anchor point, fix mode, width, height, azimuth and elevation angles, mirroring, floor plan display option, pens, line types, section fill and pens, surface and the use-the-library-part's-settings flags - the same settings CreateSkylights takes and GetDetailsOfElements returns. Only the given settings change. Not written by this command: the owner roof or shell, the anchor level and the vertical link (Archicad places the skylight on its owner), the plane of a multi-plane roof it sits on, the dimension marker (a separate element) and the library part's own parameters (use SetGDLParametersOfElements). Archicad may set the elevation angle again from the owner.

name: ModifySlabs
description: Modifies Slab elements based on the given parameters. CreateSlabs takes the same surfaces, cut fill pens and floor fill. Not written: the surface of a single edge, and the cut fill pens before Archicad 27. Of the cover fill orientation, Archicad applies only the type to a Slab through the API; a given origin or distortion matrix that did not stick gets a failed execution result, while the other details are applied.

name: ModifyStairs
description: Modifies Stair elements in place, keeping their baseline and position: the flight width, total height, number of steps, riser height and going with their locks, the finish and structure visibility, the extra top and bottom treads, the walking line position and offset, the step numbering, the walking direction, the uniform finish, monolith and draining settings, and for the flights and the landings the tread and riser settings (presence, thickness, offset, nosing, riser cross section and position) and the structure of each side (presence, type, underside shape and thickness). CreateStairs accepts the same settings. Only the given settings are changed. Archicad solves the stair again within its baseline, so it may adjust the step values; read them back with GetDetailsOfElements. Not written by this command: the baseline with its landings and winders, the top link, the floor plan display (symbol and marker layout), the headroom and the stair rules; the subelements (treads, risers, structures) take the per-part settings above and cannot be written one by one through the API.

name: ModifyTexts
description: Modifies standalone Text elements based on the given parameters.

name: ModifyWalls
description: Modifies Wall elements based on the given parameters. Takes the same wall settings as CreateWalls, applied by the same code, plus geometryType (Straight or Trapezoid), profileType and bottomOffset. Neither command can write a Polygonal outline (it needs an outline polygon, which these commands do not take), connectionPriority or junctionSequence (Archicad ignores writes to them; GetDetailsOfElements reads them), and on Archicad 29 any story visibility other than 'Home story only' and 'All relevant stories'.

name: ModifyWindows
description: Modifies Window elements based on the given parameters.

name: ModifyZones
