description: Modifies Zone elements: name, number, category, zone stamp, height, base offset, top link, floor thickness, contour line and cover fill - the same settings as CreateZones, applied by the same helpers. Only the given fields are changed. The polygon of a manual zone cannot be changed here (the change takes no polygon memo), nor the reference point of an automatic one (SetDetailsOfElements moves it).

name: MoveAttributesAndFolders
description: Moves attributes and attribute folders (with their contents) into the target folder, which must be of the same attribute type; an empty target path is the root folder. Returns one execution result per attribute and per folder; an attribute or folder that is already directly in the target folder counts as moved. Available from Archicad 26.

name: MoveDesignOptionsToAnotherSet
description: Moves the given design options to another sets. Available from Archicad 29.

name: MoveElements
description: Moves elements with a given vector. An element that cannot be edited (its layer is hidden or locked, it is locked, or it is not available in teamwork) gets a failed execution result naming the reason instead of being skipped silently.

name: MoveElementsToDesignOptions
description: Moves the given elements into the given design options. Use NULLGuid for design option to remove the element from any design options and move it to the main model. Available from Archicad 29.

name: MoveFavoriteFolder
description: Moves a folder of the Favorites palette, with its Favorites and subfolders, into another folder. Folders are given as their path of folder names from the root. Returns the new path of the folder. Available from Archicad 29.

name: MoveFavorites
description: Moves Favorites given by their names into a folder of the Favorites palette given by its path. Returns an execution result for each Favorite. Available from Archicad 29.

name: MoveGraphicOverrideRules
description: Moves graphic override rules to another rule group, or to another place in their own group. Available from Archicad 27.

name: MoveNavigatorItem
description: Moves a navigator item to a new parent in the navigator tree, or to a new position within its current parent. Fails when Archicad does not put the item where it was asked to.

name: MoveProjectInfoFields
description: Moves fields of the Project Info groups to a group, before another field of it or to its end. A subfield of a calculated field moves with its parent field. Available from Archicad 30.

name: MoveProjectInfoGroups
description: Moves Project Info groups before another group, or to the end of the group list when no other group is given. Available from Archicad 30.

name: NewProject
description: Starts a new, untitled project from the template set in Archicad's New Project settings, as File > New does; with newAndReset also the working environment is reset, as New and Reset All does. The unsaved changes of the open project are discarded, as with OpenProject.

name: OpenLibraryPartInEditor
description: Opens a loaded library part, given by its fileName or documentName as returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts, in Archicad's library part editor. Available from Archicad 27.

name: OpenProject
description: Opens the given project. The unsaved changes of the open project are discarded without asking: Archicad has no query for them, so call SaveProject first when they must be kept.

name: OpenSettingsDialog
description: Opens Archicad's settings dialog of the selected elements or the current tool (Archicad 28 and later), or the default settings dialog of the given element type, waits for the user and reports whether the dialog was closed with OK or Cancel.

name: PhotoRender
description: Renders the 3D model with the current rendering scene, or with the given one, as Document > Creative Imaging > PhotoRender Projection does, and saves the image to a file (png, jpg, bmp, tiff or gif). The image size, resolution and quality come from the scene; a width, height or resolution given here is used for this render only, the scene is not changed. With overwrite false it refuses to replace an existing file.

name: PickAttribute
description: Opens a small dialog with Archicad's attribute picker for the given attribute type (layer, building material, composite, profile or surface; fill and line from Archicad 27), waits for the user and returns the chosen attribute, or cancelled. Available from Archicad 26.

name: PickAttributeFolder
description: Opens a small dialog with Archicad's attribute folder picker for the given attribute type, waits for the user and returns the chosen folder as its path from the root folder, or cancelled. Available from Archicad 26.

name: PickLibraryFolder
description: Opens Archicad's dialog for choosing or creating a library folder, waits for the user and returns the location of the folder, or reports that the user cancelled. The folder is not added to the libraries of the project.

name: PickLibraryPart
description: Opens Archicad's Object, Lamp, Window or Door Settings dialog, optionally limited to a library part subtype, lets the user pick a library part and set its parameters, and returns the chosen library part with its GDL parameters, or that the user cancelled. Places nothing.

name: PickLibraryPartFile
description: Opens Archicad's Open Library Part dialog, waits for the user and returns the location of the chosen library part, or reports that the user cancelled.

name: PickLibraryPartSaveLocation
description: Opens Archicad's Save Library Part dialog (object, door or window), waits for the user and returns the location chosen to save the library part to, or reports that the user cancelled. Nothing is saved.

name: PickPictureFile
description: Opens Archicad's Open Picture dialog (the one of the texture settings), waits for the user and returns the location of the chosen picture, or reports that the user cancelled. Archicad adds the chosen picture to the embedded library when it is not in it yet.

name: PickZoneStampOrLabelFile
description: Opens Archicad's dialog for opening a zone stamp or label library part, waits for the user and returns the location of the chosen file, or reports that the user cancelled.

name: PlaceOpenings
description: Places openings with the Opening tool settings at points of their parent elements. A point off the parent element's surface is moved to the closest point of the surface. Each opening can be given its own extrusion and floor plan settings, which change only that opening and not the tool's settings. Available from Archicad 29.

name: PrintView
description: Prints from the current view.

name: PublishPublisherSet
description: Performs a publish operation on the currently opened project. Only the given publisher set will be published.

name: QuitArchicad
description: Performs a quit operation on the currently running Archicad instance.

name: ReadFavoritesFile
description: Read the Favorites of a .prefs file or folder without importing them, returning the name, element type and folder of each. Nothing in the project changes, so the result can be compared with the project's Favorites before ImportFavorites.

name: RebuildCurrentDatabase
description: Rebuilds the current database, the one the API works on (see ChangeWindow). Requires Archicad 27 or later.

name: RebuildView
description: Rebuilds the current view.

name: RedrawCurrentDatabase
description: Redraws the current database, even when its window is in the background. Only the visible region of its window is updated.

name: RefreshElements
description: Refreshes (rebuilds) the given elements, for example placed Objects, Windows and Doors that still show the old geometry after their library part's script or embedded file changed. Set force to true to run the parameter script of GDL-based elements too. The elements are looked up in the current database (floor plan, section or detail window). Returns an execution result for each input element. The refresh cannot be undone.

name: RegularizePolygons
description: Regularizes polygons with Archicad's own polygon regularization, before they are used to create slabs, zones or fills: removes duplicate points, fixes the orientation, resolves self-intersections and touching holes. Each input polygon gives 0, 1 or more valid polygons in the format of CreateSlabs, optionally with the input vertex and edge each result vertex and edge came from. Changes nothing in the project.

name: RegularizePolylines
description: Regularizes polylines with Archicad's own polyline regularization: removes repeated consecutive points. The result is in the format of CreatePolylines and may be empty, optionally with the input point and segment each result point and segment came from. Changes nothing in the project.

name: ReindexAttributes
description: Moves fills, line types, surfaces, building materials and zone categories to new indices, the way ReindexLayers moves layers. Archicad cannot renumber an attribute, so the attribute is recreated at its new index (free indices below it are filled with temporary attributes, which are deleted again) and every reference to the old index is rewritten to the new one: the fields of the elements in the floor plan and in every view and layout, the parameters of library part based elements, the memo data of roofs, slabs, meshes, morphs, curtain walls, beams, columns, stairs and interior elevations, the tool defaults, the Favorites (with their sub-elements: a curtain wall's frame and panel classes, a stair's structures), the other attributes that refer to it (composites, building materials, surfaces, profiles, MEP systems) and the graphic override rules. Only then is the old attribute deleted. The new attribute has a new attribute id (Archicad does not keep a given id); its name, definition and attribute folder are the old ones. Elements on a hidden or locked layer cannot be changed, so their layers are shown and unlocked for the move and put back afterwards (in the current window, as Archicad keeps these flags per window). If an element still cannot be changed (it is locked itself, or not reserved in Teamwork), everything is put back and that attribute is not moved. Elements from hotlinked modules cannot be changed and are listed; their module file has to be reindexed on its own. Indices typed into GDL scripts are not found, and the frame and panel classes of curtain wall Favorites and of the Curtain Wall tool default keep the old index (Archicad does not take them from ACAPI_Favorite_Change, so such Favorites are left as they are and named in the warnings). dryRun lists every reference without changing anything. The whole call is one undo step. Pens, layers (see ReindexLayers) and the other attribute types are not supported. Available from Archicad 27.

name: ReindexLayers
description: Moves layers to new indices. Archicad cannot renumber an attribute, so each layer is recreated at its new index (free indices below it are filled with temporary layers, which are deleted again), gets the old layer's state in every layer combination, and then every element of the old layer is moved to it, in the floor plan and in every view and layout database, with the tool defaults on that layer. Only when the old layer is empty everywhere is it deleted, and the new layer gets its name, flags and folder. If an element cannot be moved (it is locked, not reserved in Teamwork, or comes from a hotlinked module), that layer is left as it was. The new layer has a new attribute id; Favorites that use the layer are not updated. Archicad keeps the shown, locked and wireframe state of a layer per open window: the new layer gets the old one's state in the current window and in every layer combination, and starts shown and unlocked in the other open windows. The model elements that sections, elevations, interior elevations and 3D documents show of the layer come back on the new layer when those views are rebuilt (listed as viewsToRebuild). dryRun lists the elements and tool defaults on each layer without changing anything. The whole call is one undo step. Available from Archicad 27.

name: ReleaseElementState
description: Frees a state captured by CaptureElementState. Every state is freed anyway when the project is closed or Archicad quits.

name: ReleaseElements
description: Releases elements in Teamwork mode. Fails, naming them, when any of the given GUIDs is not an element; the other elements are released.

name: ReleaseHotlinkCacheManagement
description: Releases the Hotlink and XRef management in Teamwork mode.

name: ReleaseLockableObjectSet
description: Releases a non-element lockable object set reserved with ReserveLockableObjectSet in Teamwork mode.

name: ReleaseProjectData
description: Releases the project data with the given names in Teamwork.

name: ReloadLibraries
description: Executes the reload libraries command.

name: RemoveElementNotificationClient
description: Removes an element notification client.

name: RemoveElementTrims
description: Removes the trim between an element and the roof or shell trimming it. The Archicad API removes the trimming connection between the two elements, so when they trim each other (two roofs or shells) both directions are removed; trim the other direction again with TrimElements to keep it. With dryRun true nothing is removed and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and each pair whose element is trimmed by its trimming element gets wouldDelete.

name: RemoveIFCClassificationReferencesOfElements
description: Removes IFC classification references stored on elements, given by the name of their classification and optionally their identification; without identification every stored reference of that classification is removed. Available only in Archicad 25, 26 and 27 for now. With dryRun true nothing is removed and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and each element that has a matching stored reference gets wouldDelete.

name: RemoveIFCPropertiesOfElements
description: Removes local IFC properties, given by property set and property name, from elements. Available only in Archicad 25, 26 and 27 for now. With dryRun true nothing is removed and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and each element that has the local IFC property gets wouldDelete.

name: RemoveLibrariesFromBIMcloud
description: Removes libraries, given by name, from a folder of a BIMcloud or Teamwork server. Returns a result per library. Available from Archicad 29.

name: RemovePropertyFromAttributes
description: Makes a custom property unavailable for the given attributes (for example Building Materials), in one undo step. Available in Archicad 25, 26 and 27 only. With dryRun true nothing is changed and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and wouldDelete when the property and every attribute exist.

name: RemoveSolidElementLinks
description: Removes solid element operation links between target and operator elements. With dryRun true nothing is removed and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and each link that exists gets wouldDelete.

name: RenameAttributeFolders
description: Renames attribute folders, each given by attribute type and path, to the given new names. The root folder cannot be renamed. Available from Archicad 26.

name: RenameAttributes
description: Renames attributes of any type (layers, layer combinations, composites, surfaces, ...). Each attribute keeps its index, its id and its settings. A new name that another attribute of the same type already has is refused, and so is renaming the attributes Archicad does not allow to change (the built-in Archicad Layer, the Solid and Empty fills).

name: RenameDesignOptionCombinations
description: Changes the name of the given design option combinations. Available from Archicad 29.

name: RenameDesignOptionSets
description: Changes the name of the given design option sets. Available from Archicad 29.

name: RenameDesignOptions
description: Changes the name and/or the string id of the given design options. Available from Archicad 29.

name: RenameFavoriteFolder
description: Renames a folder of the Favorites palette given by its path. The root folder cannot be renamed. Returns the renamed folder. Available from Archicad 29.

name: RenameFavorites
description: Rename existing favorites.

name: RenameGraphicOverrideRuleGroups
description: Renames graphic override rule groups, found by name. Their rules are kept. Available from Archicad 27.

name: RenameNavigatorItem
description: Renames a navigator item or changes its ID. Renaming the Layout Book item of a placed Drawing also sets the custom name of the Drawing. newId sets the custom layout number of a layout and the custom ID of any other item. For a Project Map section, elevation, detail or worksheet the name and ID of the element behind the viewpoint are changed, for an interior elevation those of the segment the item stands for; the change is undone when the item does not show the new name. The name and ID of other Project Map items (stories, schedules, ...) cannot be changed. Fails when Archicad refuses the change or does not apply the new name or ID. With customName false the item drops its custom name and follows its Project Map source again.

name: RenameProjectInfoFields
description: Renames custom fields of the Project Info groups. Fixed (built-in) fields cannot be renamed. Available from Archicad 30.

name: RenameProjectInfoGroups
description: Renames Project Info groups. Available from Archicad 30.

name: ReorderDesignOptionSets
description: Moves the given design option sets before another set or to the end of the list. Available from Archicad 29.

name: ReorderDesignOptionsInSet
description: Moves the given design options before another design option of the same set or to the end of their set. Available from Archicad 29.

name: ReorderNavigatorItems
description: Reorders the children of a navigator item to match the given order. Works around MoveNavigatorItem being unable to reposition an item within its current parent, by bouncing it through a sibling.

name: RequestProjectData
description: Requests the project data with the given names in Teamwork from the users who have reserved it, with an optional message.

name: ReserveElements
description: Reserves elements in Teamwork mode. GUIDs that are not elements (navigator items, layouts, databases) cannot be reserved with it: they are returned in notElements and the execution result fails.

name: ReserveHotlinkCacheManagement
description: Reserves the Hotlink and XRef management in Teamwork mode, which is needed before changing hotlink nodes.

name: ReserveLockableObjectSet
description: Reserves a non-element lockable object set (attributes, favorites, project info, project preferences, etc.) in Teamwork mode. The object set is given by its Archicad API name, e.g. 'Composites', 'LayerSettingsDialog' or 'ProjectInfo'.

name: ReserveProjectData
description: Reserves the project data with the given names in Teamwork, so that other users cannot change it. Returns the users who have already reserved some of it.

name: ResetLibraries
description: Resets the loaded libraries with the Archicad API's library reset.

name: ResetZoom
description: Steps back in the zoom history of the current window, like Archicad's Zoom Back.

name: ResolveNames
description: Looks up words or phrases (for example from a user's question) among the names of the open project before they are passed to other commands: stories, layers, layer combinations, building materials, composites, profiles, surfaces, fills, lines, zone categories, element types (by API name and, from Archicad 27, by the name the Archicad interface shows), properties (by name, and by group and name together) and classifications (systems by name and version, items of every system by name and ID). For each name it returns 'found' with the items named exactly so, 'closeMatches' with the nearest names, best first (ranked by differences in case, accents, spacing and separators, shared words, one name containing the other and a few differing characters), or 'notFound' when nothing in the project is close, meaning the project has no such item and it must not be guessed. Each match carries what the other commands take: the story index, the attribute id and index, the elementType, the propertyId (with the property's group, value type and the classification items a custom property is available for), or the classificationSystemId and classificationItemId. Matching is lexical and deterministic. Read only.

name: RotateCopyElements
description: Copies elements rotated around a center on the floor plan by an angle in radians, like rotating a copy in Archicad, keeping all their settings. With count, copy n is rotated by n times the angle, which makes a circular array. Returns the new elements of each given element, in the order of the given ones; an element Archicad cannot copy gets an error naming the reason, and the other elements are still copied. All copies are one undo step.

name: RotateElements
description: Rotates elements around a reference point. An element that cannot be edited (its layer is hidden or locked, it is locked, or it is not available in teamwork) gets a failed execution result naming the reason instead of being skipped silently.

name: RunActionCenterChecks
description: Runs the given checks of the Action Center (by default the hotlink check). A successful result means the check ran, not that nothing was found: Archicad does not report the outcome to the caller, it shows the Action Center tab when the check found an issue.

name: RunParameterScriptOfElements
description: Runs the parameter script of the library part of the given elements (objects, lamps, windows, doors, etc.), so that parameter values that depend on other parameters are updated, e.g. after SetGDLParametersOfElements.

name: SaveAsModuleFile
description: Saves the given elements, or the current selection, as a hotlink module (.mod) file. With overwrite false it refuses to replace an existing file.

name: SaveCurrentWindowAsImage
description: Saves what the current window shows as an image file (png, jpg, bmp, tiff or gif), as File > Save as does with a picture format. Master layout windows are not supported: save a layout that uses the master layout instead. With overwrite false it refuses to replace an existing file.

name: SaveProject
description: Saves the currently opened project, in place or to a given path. With overwrite false it refuses to replace an existing file at the path.

name: SaveProjectAsArchive
description: Saves the open project as an archive (.pla) file, with the library parts it uses inside. With overwrite false it refuses to replace an existing file.

name: ScaleElements
description: Scales elements on the floor plan or in the current 2D view by a factor around a center point with Archicad's Resize edit, in one undo step. Resize scales X and Y by the same ratio, so factorY, if given, must equal factor. Supported types: Wall, Column, Beam, Slab, Roof, Mesh, Zone, Line, PolyLine, Arc, Circle, Spline, Hatch and Hotspot. An element of another type (library parts such as objects, lamps, doors and windows, stairs, railings, curtain walls, shells, morphs, texts, subelements, dimensions, labels, ...) or one that cannot be edited gets a failed execution result naming the reason, and the other elements are still scaled.

name: ScreenToModel
description: Converts pixel positions local to the current Archicad view window to 2D model coordinates of the current database, using the current window's size, drawing scale and zoom. It is a 2D mapping: it does not reconstruct a 3D point, and several model coordinates can map to the same pixel.

name: SearchFavorites
description: Searches project favorites by keyword (matching favorite name or folder) and/or element type.

name: SearchLibraryParts
description: Finds the loaded library parts derived from an ancestor library part (by its unique ID) whose name matches a pattern with * wildcards. Archicad returns at most 50 of them.

name: SearchProperties
description: Searches properties by name or group substring with optional filtering by property type, value type, and collection type.

name: Set3DCutPlanes
description: Sets the 3D cut planes. An empty cutPlanes array switches the 3D cut off.

name: Set3DCutawayStatus
description: Turns 3D Cutaway on or off and shows or hides the cutting planes in the 3D window. In Archicad 25-27 the 3D window may need to be open.

name: Set3DDocumentSettings
description: Changes the given settings of a 3D Document, given by its navigator item, in the form Get3DDocumentSettings returns; the settings not given are kept. Returns the settings read back after the change.

name: Set3DFilterAndCutSettings
description: Changes the 'Filter and Cut Elements in 3D' settings of the 3D window; only the given fields and the listed element types change. Returns the settings read back after the change. Available from Archicad 27.

name: Set3DProjectionSettings
description: Sets a perspective or an axonometric projection for the 3D window. Every perspective parameter but sun is required: read a known good set with Get3DProjectionSettings and pass it back, with the values to change replaced. An axonometry changes only the values given: the projection type, the azimuth, the transformation matrix and the sun. The sun of either changes only the values given in it and is kept when sun is missing. The 3D window shows the change after a rebuild (RebuildView), e.g. before SaveCurrentWindowAsImage.

name: Set3DWindowSettings
description: Changes the pixel size of the 3D window and/or the zoom (scale and displacement) of its projection; the values not given are kept. Returns the settings read back after the change. Archicad may need a rebuild of the 3D window (RebuildView) before it shows the change, e.g. before SaveCurrentWindowAsImage.

name: SetActiveDesignOptionsInCombinations
description: Sets active design options in the given combinations. Available from Archicad 29.

name: SetActiveGraphicalOverrideCombination
description: Applies a graphic override combination, given by id or by name, to the current window. The current window must be a model window (floor plan, section, elevation, 3D, ...). To remove the overrides, apply the project's 'No Overrides' combination. The saved view is not changed (see SetViewSettings for that). Available from Archicad 30.

name: SetActiveRenovationFilter
description: Sets the renovation filter of the current window (Document > Renovation > Renovation Filter), given by its renovationFilterId from GetRenovationFilters or by its name. Saved views keep their own filter: change that with SetViewSettings.

name: SetAnalyticalGenerationSettingsToNoRule
description: Sets the generation settings of the current Structural Analytical Model to no rules. Available from Archicad 27.

name: SetAnalyticalReleases
description: Replaces the releases of the given analytical members, in one undo step. Available from Archicad 26.

name: SetAnalyticalVisibilitySettings
description: Changes the given fields of the Structural Analytical Model visibility settings; the others keep their value. Available from Archicad 26.

name: SetArchicadVisibility
description: Hides or shows the Archicad application, e.g. to keep it out of the way while a batch runs. A script that hides Archicad must show it again, also when the script fails (e.g. in a finally block). Supported on Windows only; on macOS it returns an error.

name: SetAutoIntersect
description: Turns Auto-Intersection on or off. It is a setting of the running Archicad, not of the project; remember to restore the previous state afterwards.

name: SetBuiltInPropertyValuesOfAttributes
description: Sets built-in property values of attributes, writing the values of each attribute together. Custom properties are refused; set them with SetPropertyValuesOfAttributes. Returns one execution result per value.

name: SetCategoryValuesOfElements
description: Sets the category values (Structural Function, Position, Renovation Status ...) of the given elements, one element and one category per item, in a single undoable step. The value must belong to the given category, as GetElementCategories lists them; an element without that category gets a failed execution result. The names are localized: use the type and the categoryValueId in scripts. With dryRun true nothing is changed and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and each item that passes the checks made before writing gets wouldChange, with the element's value in the category now (oldValue) and the value a real run would set (newValue).

name: SetClassificationsOfAttributes
description: Sets the classifications of attributes (building materials, composites, surfaces, etc.). The given item replaces the attribute's current item in the same classification system. In order to set the classification of an attribute to unclassified in a system, omit the classificationItemId field.

name: SetClassificationsOfElementDefaults
description: Sets the classifications of the tool defaults (the settings new elements get) of the given element types. In order to set a default to unclassified, omit the classificationItemId field.

name: SetClassificationsOfElements
description: Sets the classifications of elements. In order to set the classification of an element to unclassified, omit the classificationItemId field. It works for subelements of hierarchal elements also. With dryRun true nothing is changed and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and each item that passes the checks made before writing gets wouldChange, with the element's classification in the system now (oldValue) and the one a real run would set (newValue).

name: SetCurrent3DStyle
description: Meant to make the given 3D style, one of the names Get3DStyles returns, the current one. Not available yet: it checks the name, then refuses, because Archicad's API function for it crashes Archicad.

name: SetCurrentRenderingScene
description: Makes the given rendering scene the current one, as selecting it in the PhotoRendering Settings palette does.

name: SetCurrentTool
description: Activates a tool in the Toolbox, given as GetCurrentTool or GetToolboxItems returns it; an empty input activates the Arrow. Archicad switches the tool once it processes its events, so GetCurrentTool may still return the previous tool right after this command.

name: SetCurrentWindowDrawingScale
description: Changes the drawing scale of the current (active) window, the scale shown in the bottom bar, to the given denominator: 100 for 1:100. It changes the scale of the current database: the floor plan, a section, elevation, interior elevation, detail, worksheet or 3D document window, each of which has its own. Layouts are always 1:1 and are rejected. The scale must be between 1 and 30000. The change is undoable.

name: SetCustomCurveMemberStretch
description: Sets the lengths added to the start and end of the given curve members, in one undo step. Available from Archicad 29.

name: SetDefaultDesignOption
description: Sets the given design option as the default, or the Main Model when no design option is given. Available from Archicad 29.

name: SetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews
description: Sets the design option combination the given views show, or makes them show only the main model. Available from Archicad 27.

name: SetDetailsOfElements
description: Sets the details of the given elements. Every element type: Element ID (id), story (floorIndex), layer (layerIndex) and display order (drawIndex). In typeSpecificDetails: Wall - start and end point, height, base offset, and the start and end thickness of a trapezoid wall; Zone - the ZoneSettings fields (the same as ModifyZones); Line - start and end point, pen, line type, room separator; Arc and Circle - origin, radius, angle, ratio, start and end angle (arcs only), reflected, pen, line type, room separator; Polyline - points and arcs, pen, line type, room separator; Spline - pen, line type, room separator; Hatch - outline, holes, contour pen, fill pen and background pen or colors, fill or building material, area display, room special and fill orientation; Hotspot - position, height, pen; Text - text, position, angle, height, justification; Label - the text of a text label; Drawing - position, angle, ratio, model offset, clip polygon (isCutWithFrame), name, ID and numbering, scale in Autotext, border, title library part, pen table (penTableUsageMode, penTableIndex), colorMode, isTransparentBackground, rasterizeDPI and the anchor (anchorPoint, useOwnOriginAsAnchor). Not written, because the Archicad API does not take them: the geometry of a Spline, the source of a Drawing (use ChangeDrawingLink), the Drawing Manager's update type and stored in project, and often a placed Drawing's drawingScale, which comes from its source view (the element's result then names the kept value). Other wall, slab, column, beam, stair and object settings are written by their Modify commands. An element Archicad does not let you edit (its layer is hidden or locked, it is locked, or it is not reserved by you in teamwork) gets a failed execution result naming the reason; a Drawing setting Archicad kept unchanged is named in a failed execution result too.

name: SetDialogAutoClose
description: Turns the dialog auto close on or off. While it is on, Archicad closes the dialogs it would show with their default button instead of waiting for the user, so automation is not blocked by them. To have it on already while Archicad opens a project (before any command can be sent), set the TAPIR_DIALOG_AUTOCLOSE environment variable to true for the Archicad process before starting it.

name: SetDocumentFrom3DDefaults
description: Sets the defaults a newly created 3D Document starts with. Only the given fields are changed; existing 3D Documents are not affected. The fields are the ones returned by GetDocumentFrom3DDefaults.

name: SetElementInfoStrings
description: Sets the info string of the given elements: the Element ID shown in the Info Box, which GetDetailsOfElements returns as id. Returns one execution result per element.

name: SetElementNotificationClient
description: Sets up a new notification client to receive element events.

name: SetElementUserData
description: Stores string values under keys on elements, for scripts to keep their own state per element (external database ids, sync timestamps, markers). The data is saved with the project as the user data of the Tapir add-on on the element and appears nowhere in the Archicad UI. The given keys are merged into what the element already holds: a key that exists gets the new value, other keys are left as they are, and the keys listed in keysToDelete are removed. Prefix the keys with the script's name so that scripts do not overwrite each other's data. One undo step per call; in a Teamwork project the element has to be reserved.

name: SetGDLDate
description: Sets the date GDL scripts see: year, month, day, hour, minute and second, as GetGDLDate returns them. Useful to test date-dependent library parts; set the value read with GetGDLDate back to restore it.

name: SetGDLParametersOfElements
description: Sets the given GDL parameters of the given elements. An element Archicad does not let the user edit (its layer locked, the element locked, or not reserved by the user in Teamwork) gets a failed execution result naming that reason, whatever the parameter. On a Curtain Wall Frame, A, B, ac_frameWidth and ac_frameDepth mirror the frame's contour, which Archicad derives from the frame's settings, so they are rejected instead of reporting a change that does not take effect; a frame without a library part (an invisible Boundary frame, for example) has no GDL parameters. The parameters are read back after the change, and a written parameter Archicad did not keep (e.g. one it sets from the element's own settings, like AC_TextSize_1 of a label) gives a failed execution result naming it. With dryRun true no element is changed and no undo step is created: the parameters are written to the element's parameter list and its Parameter Script runs as in a real run, the response has dryRun set to true, and each element that passes the checks made before changing it gets wouldChange, listing the parameters a real run would change (the given ones and the ones the Parameter Script changes with them) with their old and new values.

name: SetGeoLocation
description: Sets the project location details: the project location, and the survey point's position, geo-referencing parameters, visibility and lock state (the lock from Archicad 26). Omitted fields stay unchanged.

name: SetGhostStorySettings
description: Sets the Trace & Reference ghost story settings of the floor plan through its ghost record, which is created when the floor plan has none. Every field is optional; the ones left out keep their value, and without a story choice the current reference is kept.

name: SetGraphicOverrideRuleGroupOrder
description: Sets the order of the graphic override rule groups, found by name. The groups not listed keep their order and follow the listed ones. Available from Archicad 27.

name: SetGraphicOverrideRuleOrder
description: Sets the order of the rules in graphic override rule groups, found by name. The listed rules come first, in the given order; the other rules of the group keep their order after them. Available from Archicad 27.

name: SetGridSettings
description: Changes the grid and snap grid settings of the database of the current window; only the given fields change. Returns the settings read back after the change. Available from Archicad 27.

name: SetHotlinkDesignOptionTables
description: Sets the filter mode, the active combination and the active option of sets in the design option table of the given placed hotlink instances. Available from Archicad 29.

name: SetIFCAttributesOfElements
description: Sets the values of IFC attributes (Name, Description, ObjectType, Tag, ...) of elements. The attribute must be one GetIFCAttributesOfElements returns for the element; its IFC value type is kept. Available only in Archicad 25, 26 and 27 for now.

name: SetIFCClassificationReferencesOfElements
description: Stores IFC classification references (identification, name, location and the referenced classification with its name, edition, edition date, description and location) on elements. Available only in Archicad 25, 26 and 27 for now.

name: SetIFCPropertiesOfElements
description: Sets local IFC properties on elements by creating or modifying single value (IfcPropertySingleValue) properties in the given property sets. Available only in Archicad 25, 26 and 27 for now.

name: SetLast3DDefaultLevels
description: Sets the last 3D default levels of the given element types' defaults.

name: SetLayerOfElementDefaults
description: Sets the layer of the tool defaults of the given element types, so new elements of that type are placed on it. Only the layer of the defaults is changed.

name: SetLayoutSettings
description: Sets settings of layouts, including their master layout and Layout Info Panel custom data fields. In Teamwork the layout settings must be reserved first in Archicad (Layout Book > Reserve Layout Settings); the Archicad API cannot reserve them, and ReserveElements does not. GetTeamworkOwnersOfDatabases shows who holds a layout.

name: SetLibraries
description: Makes the given folders the project's local libraries; built-in, embedded, server and web libraries are kept. Set the libraries before opening a file that needs them and the missing-library dialog does not appear.

name: SetLibraryPartCustomSection
description: Creates, replaces or deletes a custom section of a loaded library part. The content is given as base64. A library part that is not editable is refused and left unchanged. Available from Archicad 28.

name: SetLibraryPartMetadata
description: Sets the author, keywords, license, license version, password and the placeable, UI default, subtype and hierarchical pages flags of loaded library parts. Only the given fields are changed. A library part that is not editable (e.g. a part of a library package or a read-only library) is refused and left unchanged. Available from Archicad 28.

name: SetLibraryPartParameters
description: Sets the parameter values, and optionally the parameter descriptions, of loaded library parts, in the format of SetGDLParametersOfElements. Only the given parameters are changed; with merge, the changed list is merged into the parameters of the part instead of replacing them. A library part that is not editable, or with an invalid value given, is left unchanged. Available from Archicad 28.

name: SetLibraryPartPictureImages
description: Sets the preview picture and the GDL pictures of a loaded library part from base64 encoded PNGs, and from Archicad 29 also their dark user interface variants. All pictures are set in one step; an invalid picture changes nothing. A library part that is not editable is refused and left unchanged. Available from Archicad 28.

name: SetLibraryPartPictures
description: Deletes the preview picture, the GDL pictures (and from Archicad 29 their dark variants) or the 2D symbol of a loaded library part, or copies the 2D symbol from another library part. A library part that is not editable is refused and left unchanged. Available from Archicad 28.

name: SetLibraryPartScripts
description: Sets and deletes the master, parameter, 2D, 3D, properties, interface and forward and backward migration scripts of loaded library parts. Only the given scripts are changed; an empty script makes the section empty, deleteScripts removes it. A library part that is not editable (e.g. a part of a library package or a read-only library) is refused and left unchanged. Available from Archicad 28.

name: SetLinkedPropertyObjectsOfElements
description: Sets how property objects (the library parts of the old listing system) are linked to the given elements, or to the element defaults of the given element types: whether the property objects matching their criteria are linked, and which one is assigned individually (0 removes the individual assignment). A link that is not given stays unchanged. All changes are made in one undoable step.

name: SetMEPPreferenceTableRows
description: Sets the given values of rows of a segment, branch, elbow or (from Archicad 29) transition preference table, found by their key (the reference ids and, for branch and elbow rows from Archicad 29, the angle). Only the given values are changed, in one undo step. On Archicad 27 a row is found by its shape and index, its value and description are set, and its index after the call is returned; the keys give the indices before the call. Available from Archicad 27.

name: SetMEPRoutingParameters
description: Sets the routing parameters of placed MEP elements: the routing segment parameters (cross section and preference table) and, from Archicad 29, the routing node parameters (elbow radius factor and preference table, transition preference table) of routing elements, and the elbow and transition parameters of routing nodes (from Archicad 29). Only the given keys are changed, with one execution result per element. A changed preference table is also set on each of the route's segments and nodes and injected into them, because Archicad 29 can otherwise keep the old one; the item fails if they still report the old table. Available from Archicad 28.

name: SetMarkerLibraryPartOfElements
description: Changes which library part the marker of the given Window and Door elements uses, given by its name (find the available ones with GetAvailableLibraryParts); only a marker library part for the opening's type is accepted. The marker gets the new library part's default parameters, which SetMarkerParametersOfElements can change afterwards; the opening's own settings are left as they are.

name: SetMarkerParametersOfElements
description: Sets the given GDL parameters of the marker of the given Window and Door elements. The opening's own settings and the other marker parameters are left as they are.

name: SetMarquee
description: Draws a marquee in the current window from a polygon or a box (optionally rotated), single- or multi-story. Called without polygon and box it removes the marquee.

name: SetMasterLayoutContext
description: Sets which layout's context the master layout of the current window is drawn in: its autotexts then show the values of the given layout. The current window must be a master layout, otherwise an error is returned. It does not assign a master layout to a layout. Available from Archicad 27.

name: SetOpeningDefault
description: Changes the settings of the Opening tool defaults, with the names GetOpeningDefault returns. Only the given settings change. Available from Archicad 29.

name: SetOpeningDetails
description: Changes the details of Opening elements: the parent element, the cut elements, the polygon, a transformation of the geometry and the extrusion parameters (constraint, limit type, linked status, shape type, size, anchor, offsets, surface overrides) returned by GetOpeningDetails. Available from Archicad 29.

name: SetOpeningFloorPlanParameters
description: Changes the floor plan parameters of Opening elements returned by GetOpeningFloorPlanParameters, and sets or removes their cut and uncut symbols. Available from Archicad 29.

name: SetOpeningSymbolParameters
description: Changes the GDL parameters of the cut and uncut floor plan symbols of Opening elements, in the format of SetGDLParametersOfElements. Only the given parameters are changed. Available from Archicad 29.

name: SetPens
description: Changes the color, width and description of the given pens in effect in the current window, the pens GetPens returns, in one undo step. Only the given fields of a listed pen are changed; each pen gets its own execution result. In a Teamwork project the PenTables lockable object set must be reserved first (see ReserveLockableObjectSet). Available from Archicad 27.

name: SetPlaceSettings
description: Changes the place settings of the project: location (longitude, latitude, altitude, north), date, time, summer time and time zone. Only the given fields change. Returns the settings read back, with the sun position Archicad calculated for them. Available from Archicad 27.

name: SetProjectData
description: Creates or overwrites project data: text (for example JSON) saved in the project under a name. New project data can be kept on this client only, or created as unique so that in Teamwork only one can exist with its name. Prefix the names with the name of your tool (for example 'my-tool/settings') so scripts do not overwrite each other's data.

name: SetProjectInfoField
description: Sets the value of a project info field.

name: SetProjectNotes
description: Changes the Project Notes of the project (File > Info > Project Notes). Only the given fields are changed; texts longer than the field Archicad stores are truncated. architect and draftsmen are full names that Archicad keeps as name parts: a new name is stored in the given name with the other parts cleared, and the parts of a name that is not given or not changed are kept.

name: SetProjectPreferences
description: Changes pages of the project preferences (Options > Project Preferences): the working units, the dimensions, the calculation units, the zones and the reference levels, and the Floor Plan Cut Plane Settings. Only the given fields change, the rest of each page keeps its value. In Teamwork the PreferencesDialog lockable object set has to be reserved first (ReserveLockableObjectSet). Available from Archicad 27.

name: SetPropertyValueOfAttributes
description: Sets one property value on several attributes (for example Building Materials) in one undo step. If the property is not available for any of the given attributes, no attribute is changed.

name: SetPropertyValuesOfAttributes
description: Sets the property values of attributes.

name: SetPropertyValuesOfElementDefaults
description: Sets the property values of the tool defaults (the settings new elements get) of element types, so every element placed afterwards gets them, without saving and applying a favorite.

name: SetPropertyValuesOfElements
description: Sets the property values of elements. It works for subelements of hierarchal elements also. With valueStatus an element's value can also be reset to the default value of the property (Default) or made undefined (UserUndefined, from 1.8.1). With dryRun true nothing is changed and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and each item that passes the checks made before writing gets wouldChange, with the element's value now (oldValue) and the value a real run would write (newValue), both as GetPropertyValuesOfElements gives them.

name: SetSectionsAndElevationsDetails
description: Sets settings of the given Section and Elevation elements: pens, line types, horizontal and vertical range, model effects, story handles and markers. The name and the reference ID are changed with ModifySections.

name: SetStories
description: Sets the story sructure of the currently loaded project.

name: SetStructureDisplay
description: Sets the Partial Structure Display (EntireStructure, CoreOnly, WithoutFinishes or StructureOnly) of the current window, e.g. the floor plan, a section or the 3D window. The change cannot be undone. The saved view is not changed (see SetViewSettings for that). Available from Archicad 27.

name: SetSuspendGroupsMode
description: Turns the Suspend Groups mode on or off. Suspend groups to perform operations on elements that are part of a group; remember to restore the previous state afterwards.

name: SetURLReferencesOfElements
description: Sets the web link (URL reference) of the given elements: a URL with a description, shown in Archicad in the element's settings under Element Information > Link. Fails with APIERR_MOREUSER for an element that already holds a link.

name: SetUserDataOfAttributes
description: Stores string values under keys in the user data of attributes, for scripts to keep their own state on an attribute. The given pairs are merged into what each attribute already holds: a key that exists gets the new value, other keys are left as they are, and the keys listed in keysToDelete are removed. Prefix the keys with the script's name so that scripts do not overwrite each other's data. User data in another layout is left unchanged and reported as an error. Archicad does not record this change as an undo step, so Undo does not revert it.

name: SetUserDataOfGroups
description: Stores string values under keys in the user data of groups, for scripts to keep their own state on a group. The given pairs are merged into what each group already holds: a key that exists gets the new value, other keys are left as they are, and the keys listed in keysToDelete are removed. Prefix the keys with the script's name so that scripts do not overwrite each other's data. User data in another layout is left unchanged and reported as an error. One undo step per call.

name: SetViewOptions
description: Switches the current plan window to a model view option combination by index, and/or changes the given model view options and on-screen view options. With an index, the model view options stored in the combination apply.

name: SetViewRotation
description: Set the rotation angle of 2D views via their floor plan database.

name: SetViewSettings
description: Sets the view settings of navigator items

name: SetZoneLabelingSettings
description: Turns the automatic labeling of Zones on or off and selects the Label Favorite it places. Only the given settings are changed. Available from Archicad 28.

name: SetZoom
description: Zooms the current 2D window to the given box in model coordinates.

name: ShowAlert
description: Display a dialog with up to three buttons.

name: ShowElementsIn3D
description: Opens the 3D window on the given elements, as Show Selection in 3D does: they become the selection and only they are shown. Without elements it shows every element, as Show All in 3D does.

name: ShowIFCExportSettings
description: Opens Archicad's IFC export settings dialog, where the user picks a view and an IFC export translator, waits for the user and returns the chosen view and translator, or cancelled. Available from Archicad 28.

name: ShowNotificationBubble
description: Shows a non-blocking notification bubble with a message in the current Archicad window, e.g. to report progress or a result without stopping the user as ShowAlert does. The bubble disappears by itself after the timeout. It is shown at a model coordinate or a pixel position of the current view, by default at the center of the current 2D view. Optionally it gets a large icon, is shown at most a given number of times, or is turned off, until the user runs 'Enable all informational messages'. Returns the bubble's settings read back from Archicad. Requires Archicad 29 or later.

name: ShowScriptUI
description: Shows the given HTML content in a native Archicad palette (a tkinter alternative for Python scripts) and returns the uiId of its window. Each script can have its own window, picked by uiId or scriptId; without them the first window is used.

name: SolveStairBaseline
description: Runs the Archicad stair solver on the given Stair baselines and parameters without creating any element. Returns for each one whether the baseline was already correct, could be solved or could not be solved, with the baseline and the main stair settings after solving. Available from Archicad 27.

name: SplitElements
description: Splits each given element along a line (the infinite line through its begin and end point, like Archicad's Split command). The original element keeps one part, copies of it (Drag a Copy, so they keep the layer, classifications, properties and every other setting) get the others; all are returned, the original first. Supports straight walls without doors, windows or openings, straight unslanted single segment beams without holes or openings, and lines (their arrows stay at the original ends), which are split in two, the original keeping the part from its begin point; and slabs, meshes without level lines or points, fills and single contour polylines, whose polygon (holes and arcs included) or points are cut along the line into one part per piece, the original keeping the largest piece (a polyline: the piece with its begin point). Slab edges keep their trim and side surface, the edges along the line are vertical; the corners a mesh gets on the line take their height from the edge they lie on. An element the line does not cross is reported as notCut, an unsupported one as an error naming its type. One undo step.

name: StoreModulData
description: Creates or overwrites module data: text (for example JSON) saved in the project under a name, with an optional data version. Prefix the names with the name of your tool (for example 'my-tool/settings') so scripts do not overwrite each other's data. Storing module data is not an undoable step.

name: StoreViewSettings
description: Stores the current view settings (action Store) and puts them back later (action Restore), for example before and after a script that changes the view. The two must be called in pairs and cannot be stacked. Restoring may rebuild the view.

name: TeamworkReceive
description: Performs a receive operation on the currently opened Teamwork project.

name: TeamworkSend
description: Performs a send operation on the currently opened Teamwork project.

name: TransferMEPSettings
description: Picks up the settings of an MEP element and injects them into other MEP elements of the same type and domain, like Archicad's pick up and inject parameters. Works for routing elements, terminals, accessories, equipment, fittings, flexible segments, branches, take-offs and (from Archicad 30) electrical panels and devices. Each target is changed in its own undoable step. Available from Archicad 28.

name: TriangulatePolygonsOfElements
description: Triangulates the plan polygon of the given elements, holes excluded, as Archicad does it: the outline of a Slab, Zone, Hatch or Mesh and the polygon of a Roof. Each triangle is given by the 2D coordinates of its three vertices. With convex: true, the faces of the 3D model of the elements (of any type) are decomposed into convex polygons instead, given by the 3D coordinates of their vertices. The output is aligned with the input array of elements; an element of another type gets an error item.

name: TrimElements
description: Trims construction elements with a roof or shell: the roofs and shells in the list, or one given trimming element with a trim type. With several roofs or shells in the list Archicad decides which of them trims which element (they may also trim each other), so not every element is necessarily trimmed by each; to trim each element with each roof or shell, call it once per roof or shell with trimmingElement, and check the result with GetElementTrims.

name: UngroupElements
description: Ungroups the given groups one level, like Edit > Grouping > Ungroup: each group is dissolved, the elements and subgroups it directly contains stay. A group nested in another group is reported as failed; ungroup the containing group first. Returns an execution result per group.

name: UnlinkElements
description: Removes the links created by LinkElements between the given pairs of elements. The direction matters: the link starting from fromElementId and pointing to toElementId is removed. Undoable.

name: UnlockElements
description: Unlocks the given elements. Manual lock, not teamwork!

name: UnmergeElements
description: Removes the merge between the two elements of each given pair. Undoable; one execution result per pair.

name: UpdateAnalyticalModel
description: Triggers an update of the given Structural Analytical Model, or of the model of the current view when no model is given. Available from Archicad 27.

name: UpdateClassificationItems
description: Updates the id (code), name and/or description of existing Classification Items, keeping their guid and so the elements classified with them. Items cannot be moved to another parent.

name: UpdateClassificationSystems
description: Updates the name, description, source, version and/or date of existing Classification Systems, keeping their guid.

name: UpdateDrawings
description: Performs a drawing update on the given elements.

name: UpdateFavoritesFromElements
description: Update existing favorites from the given elements.

name: UpdateHotlinks
description: Re-reads the source files of hotlink module nodes and refreshes their cached content in the project, as the Hotlink Manager's Update button does.

name: UpdateLibraryPartSections
description: Replaces the text of existing sections (scripts, comment, keywords, copyright) of a loaded library part, found by its name. Each section is read back after the update, and the output has one execution result per section.

name: UpdatePropertyDefinitions
description: Updates existing Custom Property Definitions in place, keeping their guid: name, description, group, default value or expressions, availability, and enum options (add, rename, remove, reorder).

name: UpdatePropertyGroups
description: Updates the name and/or description of existing Custom Property Groups, keeping their guid.

name: UpdateZones
description: Updates Zones (recalculates their geometry, updates their Zone Stamps and the connected elements): the selected Zones, every Zone when nothing is selected, or the Zones given in zones. Archicad runs the update right after the command has returned, on the Zones selected at that moment, so the new geometry can only be read with a later command.

name: UploadLibrariesToBIMcloud
description: Uploads local library folders or container files (.lcf) to a folder of a BIMcloud or Teamwork server, as BIMcloud libraries. Returns a result per library. Available from Archicad 29.

name: ZoomToElements
description: Zooms the current window, 2D or 3D, to the given elements: selects them, zooms to the selection and restores the previous selection unless keepSelection is false. Fails when none of the elements could be selected, e.g. all of them are on another story or on a hidden layer.
